   120 |     while (
   121 |         current >=
   122 |         128
   123 |     ) {
   124 |         output.push(
   125 |             (
   126 |                 current %
   127 |                 128
   128 |             ) +
   129 |             128
   130 |         );
   131 | 
   132 |         current =
   133 |             Math.floor(
   134 |                 current /
   135 |                 128
   136 |             );
   137 |     }
   138 | 
   139 |     output.push(
   140 |         current
   141 |     );
   142 | }

   353 | function sky102PlayerSlot(
   354 |     customSlot: number,
   355 |     fallback: number
   356 | ): number {
   357 |     /*
   358 |      * Current Custom Lobby layout:
   359 |      *
   360 |      * Team0 UI slots 10..15 -> server slots 0..5
   361 |      * Team1 UI slots 20..25 -> server slots 6..11
   362 |      *
   363 |      * Keep both values in diagnostics.
   364 |      */
   365 |     if (
   366 |         customSlot >= 10 &&
   367 |         customSlot <= 15
   368 |     ) {
   369 |         return customSlot - 10;
   370 |     }
   371 | 
   372 |     if (
   373 |         customSlot >= 20 &&
   374 |         customSlot <= 25
   375 |     ) {
   376 |         return 6 +
   377 |             customSlot -
   378 |             20;
   379 |     }
   380 | 
   381 |     if (
   382 |         customSlot >= 0 &&
   383 |         customSlot <= 11
   384 |     ) {
   385 |         return customSlot;
   386 |     }
   387 | 
   388 |     return fallback;
   389 | }

   391 | function sky102Team(
   392 |     member: any,
   393 |     customSlot: number
   394 | ): number {
   395 |     const direct =
   396 |         sky102Number(
   397 |             member.team,
   398 |             -1
   399 |         );
   400 | 
   401 |     if (
   402 |         direct === 0 ||
   403 |         direct === 1
   404 |     ) {
   405 |         return direct;
   406 |     }
   407 | 
   408 |     if (
   409 |         customSlot >= 20 &&
   410 |         customSlot <= 25
   411 |     ) {
   412 |         return 1;
   413 |     }
   414 | 
   415 |     return 0;
   416 | }

   418 | function sky102Hero(
   419 |     member: any

   421 |     const direct =
   422 |         sky102Number(

   426 |             member.selectedHeroId,

   432 |         0

   435 |             hero_id:
   436 |                 direct,
   437 | 
   438 |             source:
   439 |                 "member-direct",

   447 |         member.hero_roster ??

   459 |                 ""
   460 |         };

   473 |         return {
   474 |             hero_id:
   475 |                 0,
   476 | 
   477 |             source:
   478 |                 "hero_roster-not-array",
   479 | 
   480 |             candidates:
   481 |                 ""
   482 |         };
   483 |     }
   484 | 
   485 |     let selectedHero =
   486 |         0;
   487 | 
   488 |     let selectedPriority =
   489 |         2147483647;
   490 | 
   491 |     let candidates =
   492 |         "";
   493 | 
   494 |     let index =
   495 |         0;
   496 | 
   497 |     while (
   498 |         index <

   531 |                 ":p" +

   534 |             /*

   536 |              * Missing/zero priority comes last.
   537 |              */
   538 |             const normalizedPriority =
   539 |                 priority >
   540 |                 0
   541 |                     ? priority
   542 |                     : 2147483647;
   543 | 
   544 |             if (

   553 |                     normalizedPriority;
   554 |             }

   558 |     }

   561 |         hero_id:
   562 |             selectedHero,

   567 |         candidates:
   568 |             candidates
   569 |     };

     1 | using SKYNET_server.Models;
     2 | using System.Text.Json;
     3 | using TypeSharp.Hosting;
     4 | using TypeSharp.VM.Memory;
     5 | 
     6 | namespace SKYNET_server.Services;
     7 | 
     8 | public sealed class GameCoordinatorScriptPlugin : IGameCoordinatorPlugin, IGameCoordinatorTicker
     9 | {
    10 |     private const long ScriptMemoryLimitBytes = 768L * 1024 * 1024;
    11 |     private const long ScriptMaximumInstructions = 100_000_000;
    12 |     private static readonly TimeSpan ScriptExecutionTimeout = TimeSpan.FromSeconds(120);
    13 |     private readonly ILogger<GameCoordinatorScriptPlugin> _logger;
    14 |     private readonly GameCoordinatorTraceService _trace;
    15 |     private readonly string _gcRoot;
    16 |     private readonly GameCoordinatorAppCatalog _apps;
    17 |     private readonly GameCoordinatorProtoCodec _codec = new();
    18 |     private readonly object _cacheSync = new();
    19 |     private readonly Dictionary<uint, CachedScript> _cache = new();
    20 | 
    21 |     public GameCoordinatorScriptPlugin(
    22 |         IHostEnvironment hostEnvironment,
    23 |         ILogger<GameCoordinatorScriptPlugin> logger,
    24 |         GameCoordinatorTraceService trace)
    25 |     {
    26 |         _logger = logger;
    27 |         _trace = trace;
    28 |         _gcRoot = GameCoordinatorAppCatalog.ResolveRoot(hostEnvironment.ContentRootPath);
    29 |         _apps = new GameCoordinatorAppCatalog(_gcRoot);
    30 |         _logger.LogInformation("GC script root resolved to {GCRoot}", _gcRoot);
    31 |     }
    32 | 
    33 |     public bool CanHandle(uint appId)
    34 |     {
    35 |         if (_apps.TryGetApp(appId, out _, out var error))
    36 |         {
    37 |             return true;
    38 |         }
    39 | 
    40 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(error))
    41 |         {
    42 |             _logger.LogWarning("GC app {AppId} is unavailable: {Reason}", appId, error);
    43 |         }
    44 | 
    45 |         return false;
    46 |     }
    47 | 
    48 |     public ApiGCExchangeResponse Exchange(GameCoordinatorContext context, ApiGCExchangeRequest request)
    49 |     {
    50 |         if (!_apps.TryGetApp(context.AppId, out var app, out var catalogError))
    51 |         {
    52 |             if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(catalogError))
    53 |             {
    54 |                 _logger.LogWarning("GC app {AppId} cannot handle message {MessageType}: {Reason}",
    55 |                     context.AppId, request.MessageType, catalogError);
    56 |                 _trace.Record("error", context.AppId, context.SteamId, request.MessageType, 0, catalogError);
    57 |             }
    58 | 
    59 |             return new ApiGCExchangeResponse { Handled = false };
    60 |         }
    61 | 
    62 |         _trace.Record("in", context.AppId, context.SteamId, request.MessageType,
    63 |             GameCoordinatorTraceService.EstimatePayloadSize(request.BodyBase64), context.PersonaName);
    64 | 
    65 |         try
    66 |         {
    67 |             var cacheEntry = GetCachedScript(app);
    68 |             lock (cacheEntry.Sync)
    69 |             {
    70 |                 var host = new ScriptExchangeHost(context, request, _codec, _logger, _trace);
    71 |                 cacheEntry.Dispatcher.Current = host;
    72 |                 try
    73 |                 {
    74 |                     var handled = cacheEntry.Runtime
    75 |                         .InvokeAsync<bool>(context.AppId.ToString(), "handle")
    76 |                         .GetAwaiter()
    77 |                         .GetResult();
    78 |                     if (!handled)
    79 |                     {
    80 |                         _trace.Record("unhandled", context.AppId, context.SteamId, request.MessageType, 0);
    81 |                         return new ApiGCExchangeResponse { Handled = false };
    82 |                     }
    83 | 
    84 |                     foreach (var message in host.Response.Messages)
    85 |                     {
    86 |                         _trace.Record("out", context.AppId, context.SteamId, message.MessageType,
    87 |                             GameCoordinatorTraceService.EstimatePayloadSize(message.PayloadBase64),
    88 |                             message.TargetJobId == null ? string.Empty : $"job {message.TargetJobId}");
    89 |                     }
    90 | 
    91 |                     return host.Response;
    92 |                 }
    93 |                 finally
    94 |                 {
    95 |                     cacheEntry.Dispatcher.Current = null;
    96 |                 }
    97 |             }
    98 |         }
    99 |         catch (Exception ex)
   100 |         {
   101 |             _logger.LogError(ex, "GC script failed for app {AppId}, message {MessageType}",
   102 |                 context.AppId, request.MessageType);
   103 |             _trace.Record("error", context.AppId, context.SteamId, request.MessageType, 0, ex.ToString());
   104 |             return new ApiGCExchangeResponse { Handled = false };
   105 |         }
   106 |     }
   107 | 
   108 |     public ApiGCExchangeResponse Poll(GameCoordinatorContext context)
   109 |     {
   110 |         var response = new ApiGCExchangeResponse { Handled = true };
   111 |         response.Messages.AddRange(GameCoordinatorPendingMessages.Drain(context.AppId, context.SteamId));
   112 |         return response;
   113 |     }
   114 | 
   115 |     public void Tick()
   116 |     {
   117 |         List<uint> appIds;
   118 |         lock (_cacheSync)
   119 |         {
   120 |             appIds = _cache.Keys.ToList();
   121 |         }
   122 | 
   123 |         foreach (var appId in appIds)
   124 |         {
   125 |             if (!_apps.TryGetApp(appId, out var app, out var catalogError))
   126 |             {
   127 |                 if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(catalogError))
   128 |                 {
   129 |                     _logger.LogWarning("GC app {AppId} tick skipped: {Reason}", appId, catalogError);
   130 |                 }
   131 | 
   132 |                 continue;
   133 |             }
   134 | 
   135 |             try
   136 |             {
   137 |                 var cacheEntry = GetCachedScript(app);
   138 |                 lock (cacheEntry.Sync)
   139 |                 {
   140 |                     var host = new ScriptExchangeHost(
   141 |                         new GameCoordinatorContext { AppId = appId },
   142 |                         new ApiGCExchangeRequest { AppId = appId },
   143 |                         _codec,
   144 |                         _logger,
   145 |                         _trace);
   146 |                     cacheEntry.Dispatcher.Current = host;
   147 |                     try
   148 |                     {
   149 |                         cacheEntry.Runtime
   150 |                             .InvokeAsync<object?>(appId.ToString(), "tick")
   151 |                             .GetAwaiter()
   152 |                             .GetResult();
   153 |                     }
   154 |                     catch (InvalidOperationException ex) when (ex.Message.Contains("Function 'tick' not found", StringComparison.Ordinal))
   155 |                     {
   156 |                     }
   157 |                     finally
   158 |                     {
   159 |                         cacheEntry.Dispatcher.Current = null;
   160 |                     }
   161 |                 }
   162 |             }
   163 |             catch (Exception ex)
   164 |             {
   165 |                 _logger.LogError(ex, "GC script tick failed for app {AppId}", appId);
   166 |                 _trace.Record("error", appId, 0, 0, 0, $"tick: {ex.Message}");
   167 |             }
   168 |         }
   169 |     }
   170 | 
   171 |     private CachedScript GetCachedScript(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   172 |     {
   173 |         var appId = app.AppId;
   174 |         var scriptRoot = app.RootPath;
   175 |         var cacheKey = GetScriptCacheKey(app);
   176 |         lock (_cacheSync)
   177 |         {
   178 |             if (_cache.TryGetValue(appId, out var cached) && cached.CacheKey == cacheKey)
   179 |             {
   180 |                 return cached;
   181 |             }
   182 | 
   183 |             _codec.ConfigureApp(app, typeof(GameCoordinatorScriptPlugin).Assembly);
   184 | 
   185 |             var dispatcher = new ScriptHostDispatcher();
   186 |             var builder = new TypeSharpRuntimeBuilder()
   187 |                 .ConfigureLimits(options =>
   188 |                 {
   189 |                     options.ExecutionTimeout = ScriptExecutionTimeout;
   190 |                     options.MaximumInstructions = ScriptMaximumInstructions;
   191 |                     options.MaximumMemoryBytes = ScriptMemoryLimitBytes;
   192 |                 })
   193 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "messageType", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().MessageType())
   194 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "body", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().Body())
   195 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "appId", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().AppId())
   196 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "steamId", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().SteamId())
   197 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "accountId", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().AccountId())
   198 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "personaName", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().PersonaName())
   199 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "now", _ => dispatcher.RequireCurrent().Now())
   200 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "log", dispatcher.Log)
   201 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "decode", dispatcher.Decode)
   202 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "encode", dispatcher.Encode)
   203 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "send", dispatcher.Send)
   204 |                 .RegisterHostFunction("gc", "reply", dispatcher.Reply);
   205 | 
   206 |             RegisterAppHostServices(builder, dispatcher, app);
   207 | 
   208 |             foreach (var sourceFile in EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(app))
   209 |             {
   210 |                 builder.AddSourceFile(sourceFile);
   211 |             }
   212 | 
   213 |             var runtime = builder.BuildAsync().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
   214 |             if (_cache.TryGetValue(appId, out var old))
   215 |             {
   216 |                 old.Runtime.DisposeAsync().AsTask().GetAwaiter().GetResult();
   217 |             }
   218 | 
   219 |             cached = new CachedScript(runtime, dispatcher, cacheKey);
   220 |             _cache[appId] = cached;
   221 |             _logger.LogInformation("GC script loaded for app {AppId} from {ScriptRoot}", appId, scriptRoot);
   222 |             return cached;
   223 |         }
   224 |     }
   225 | 
   226 | 
   227 |     private static void RegisterAppHostServices(
   228 |         TypeSharpRuntimeBuilder builder,
   229 |         ScriptHostDispatcher dispatcher,
   230 |         GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   231 |     {
   232 |         foreach (var serviceName in app.HostServices)
   233 |         {
   234 |             if (string.Equals(serviceName, DotaGcRuntimeServices.HostServiceName, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
   235 |             {
   236 |                 if (app.AppId != DotaGcRuntimeServices.AppId)
   237 |                 {
   238 |                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
   239 |                         $"GC app {app.AppId} is not authorized for host service '{serviceName}' in {app.ManifestPath}");
   240 |                 }
   241 | 
   242 |                 RegisterDotaHostFunctions(builder, dispatcher);
   243 |                 continue;
   244 |             }
   245 | 
   246 |             
   247 |             // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_HOST_SERVICE_V1
   248 |             if (string.Equals(
   249 |                     serviceName,
   250 |                     DeadlockGcRuntimeServices.HostServiceName,
   251 |                     StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase))
   252 |             {
   253 |                 if (app.AppId != DeadlockGcRuntimeServices.AppId)
   254 |                 {
   255 |                     throw new InvalidOperationException(
   256 |                         $"GC app {app.AppId} is not authorized for host service '{serviceName}' in {app.ManifestPath}");
   257 |                 }
   258 | 
   259 |                 RegisterDeadlockHostFunctions(
   260 |                     builder,
   261 |                     dispatcher
   262 |                 );
   263 | 
   264 |                 continue;
   265 |             }
   266 | 
   267 | throw new InvalidOperationException(
   268 |                 $"GC app {app.AppId} declares unsupported host service '{serviceName}' in {app.ManifestPath}");
   269 |         }
   270 |     }

   494 | 
   495 |     private static string GetScriptCacheKey(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   496 |     {
   497 |         var fileIdentities = EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(app)
   498 |             .OrderBy(path => path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   499 |             .Select(path =>
   500 |             {
   501 |                 var file = new FileInfo(path);
   502 |                 return string.Join(':', Path.GetRelativePath(app.RootPath, path), file.Length, file.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks);
   503 |             });
   504 | 
   505 |         return string.Join('|', new[] { app.RuntimeCacheKey }.Concat(fileIdentities));
   506 |     }
   507 | 
   508 |     private static IEnumerable<string> EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   509 |     {
   510 |         var seen = new HashSet<string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase);
   511 |         if (File.Exists(app.MainScriptPath) && seen.Add(Path.GetFullPath(app.MainScriptPath)))
   512 |         {
   513 |             yield return app.MainScriptPath;
   514 |         }
   515 | 
   516 |         foreach (var directoryName in new[] { "framework", "generated", "modules" })
   517 |         {
   518 |             var directory = Path.Combine(app.RootPath, directoryName);
   519 |             if (!Directory.Exists(directory))
   520 |             {
   521 |                 continue;
   522 |             }
   523 | 
   524 |             foreach (var file in Directory.EnumerateFiles(directory, "*.ts", SearchOption.AllDirectories)
   525 |                          .Where(path => !path.EndsWith(".d.ts", StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase)))
   526 |             {
   527 |                 var fullPath = Path.GetFullPath(file);
   528 |                 if (seen.Add(fullPath))
   529 |                 {
   530 |                     yield return fullPath;
   531 |                 }
   532 |             }
   533 |         }
   534 |     }

   550 |     }
   551 | }

  1167 | internal sealed class ScriptExchangeHost
  1168 | {
  1169 |     private const uint DotaActiveEventId = 57;
  1170 |     private readonly GameCoordinatorContext _context;
  1171 |     private readonly ApiGCExchangeRequest _request;
  1172 |     private readonly GameCoordinatorProtoCodec _codec;
  1173 |     private readonly ILogger _logger;
  1174 | 
  1175 |     public ScriptExchangeHost(
  1176 |         GameCoordinatorContext context,
  1177 |         ApiGCExchangeRequest request,
  1178 |         GameCoordinatorProtoCodec codec,
  1179 |         ILogger logger,
  1180 |         GameCoordinatorTraceService trace)
  1181 |     {
  1182 |         _context = context;
  1183 |         _request = request;
  1184 |         _codec = codec;
  1185 |         _logger = logger;
  1186 |         Response = new ApiGCExchangeResponse { Handled = true };
  1187 |     }
  1188 | 
  1189 |     public ApiGCExchangeResponse Response { get; }
  1190 | 
  1191 |     public TsValue MessageType() => TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)_request.MessageType));
  1192 | 
  1193 |     public TsValue Body()
  1194 |     {
  1195 |         return ToArray(Convert.FromBase64String(_request.BodyBase64 ?? string.Empty));
  1196 |     }
  1197 | 
  1198 |     public TsValue AppId() => TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)_context.AppId));
  1199 | 
  1200 |     public TsValue SteamId() => TsValue.FromUInt64(_context.SteamId);
  1201 | 
  1202 |     public TsValue AccountId() => TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)_context.AccountId));
  1203 | 
  1204 |     public TsValue PersonaName() => TsValue.FromString(_context.PersonaName);
  1205 | 
  1206 |     public TsValue Now() => TsValue.FromInt64(DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds());
  1207 | 
  1208 | 
  1209 | 
  1210 |     // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_MATCH_HISTORY_DB_HOST_V1
  1211 |     //
  1212 |     // Exposes an actual TypeSharp array to GC scripts.
  1213 |     // Scripts do not need JSON.parse().
  1214 |     public TsValue DeadlockMatchHistory(
  1215 |         TsValue[] args)
  1216 |     {
  1217 |         var accountId =
  1218 |             args.Length > 0
  1219 |                 ? checked(
  1220 |                     (uint)ToInteger(
  1221 |                         args[0],
  1222 |                         "deadlockMatchHistory.accountId"
  1223 |                     )
  1224 |                 )
  1225 |                 : _context.AccountId;
  1226 | 
  1227 |         if (
  1228 |             accountId == 0
  1229 |         )
  1230 |         {
  1231 |             accountId =
  1232 |                 _context.AccountId;
  1233 |         }
  1234 | 
  1235 |         var json =
  1236 |             DeadlockGcRuntimeServices
  1237 |                 .MatchHistoryJsonProvider?
  1238 |                 .Invoke(
  1239 |                     accountId
  1240 |                 ) ??
  1241 |             "[]";
  1242 | 
  1243 |         using var document =
  1244 |             System.Text.Json.JsonDocument.Parse(
  1245 |                 string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
  1246 |                     json
  1247 |                 )
  1248 |                     ? "[]"
  1249 |                     : json
  1250 |             );
  1251 | 
  1252 |         var result =
  1253 |             new TsArray();
  1254 | 
  1255 |         if (
  1256 |             document.RootElement.ValueKind !=
  1257 |             JsonValueKind.Array
  1258 |         )
  1259 |         {
  1260 |             return new TsArrayValue(
  1261 |                 result
  1262 |             );
  1263 |         }
  1264 | 
  1265 |         static long ReadInt64(
  1266 |             JsonElement element,
  1267 |             string name,
  1268 |             long fallback = 0)
  1269 |         {
  1270 |             if (
  1271 |                 element.ValueKind !=
  1272 |                 JsonValueKind.Object
  1273 |             )
  1274 |             {
  1275 |                 return fallback;
  1276 |             }
  1277 | 
  1278 |             if (
  1279 |                 !element.TryGetProperty(
  1280 |                     name,
  1281 |                     out var property
  1282 |                 )
  1283 |             )
  1284 |             {
  1285 |                 return fallback;
  1286 |             }
  1287 | 
  1288 |             if (
  1289 |                 property.ValueKind ==
  1290 |                     JsonValueKind.Number &&
  1291 |                 property.TryGetInt64(
  1292 |                     out var number
  1293 |                 )
  1294 |             )
  1295 |             {
  1296 |                 return number;
  1297 |             }
  1298 | 
  1299 |             if (
  1300 |                 property.ValueKind ==
  1301 |                     JsonValueKind.String &&
  1302 |                 long.TryParse(
  1303 |                     property.GetString(),
  1304 |                     out var parsed
  1305 |                 )
  1306 |             )
  1307 |             {
  1308 |                 return parsed;
  1309 |             }
  1310 | 
  1311 |             return fallback;
  1312 |         }
  1313 | 
  1314 |         static int ReadInt32(
  1315 |             JsonElement element,
  1316 |             string name,
  1317 |             int fallback = 0)
  1318 |         {
  1319 |             var value =
  1320 |                 ReadInt64(
  1321 |                     element,
  1322 |                     name,
  1323 |                     fallback
  1324 |                 );
  1325 | 
  1326 |             if (
  1327 |                 value >
  1328 |                 int.MaxValue
  1329 |             )
  1330 |             {
  1331 |                 return int.MaxValue;
  1332 |             }
  1333 | 
  1334 |             if (
  1335 |                 value <
  1336 |                 int.MinValue
  1337 |             )
  1338 |             {
  1339 |                 return int.MinValue;
  1340 |             }
  1341 | 
  1342 |             return Convert.ToInt32(
  1343 |                 value
  1344 |             );
  1345 |         }

  2117 | 
  2118 |     private static uint DeadlockJsonUInt32(
  2119 |         System.Text.Json.JsonElement value,
  2120 |         string propertyName,
  2121 |         uint fallback)
  2122 |     {
  2123 |         if (
  2124 |             value.ValueKind !=
  2125 |                 System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Object ||
  2126 |             !value.TryGetProperty(
  2127 |                 propertyName,
  2128 |                 out var property
  2129 |             ) ||
  2130 |             property.ValueKind !=
  2131 |                 System.Text.Json.JsonValueKind.Number
  2132 |         )
  2133 |         {
  2134 |             return fallback;
  2135 |         }
  2136 | 
  2137 |         if (
  2138 |             property.TryGetUInt32(
  2139 |                 out var unsigned
  2140 |             )
  2141 |         )
  2142 |         {
  2143 |             return unsigned;
  2144 |         }
  2145 | 
  2146 |         if (
  2147 |             property.TryGetInt64(
  2148 |                 out var signed
  2149 |             ) &&
  2150 |             signed >= 0 &&
  2151 |             signed <= uint.MaxValue
  2152 |         )
  2153 |         {
  2154 |             return unchecked(
  2155 |                 (uint)signed
  2156 |             );

  2582 |     public TsValue DotaResolveGameServerConnectIps(TsValue[] args)
  2583 |     {
  2584 |         if (args.Length < 3)
  2585 |         {
  2586 |             throw new InvalidOperationException("dotaResolveGameServerConnectIps(publicIp, privateIp, fallbackIp) requires three arguments");
  2587 |         }
  2588 | 
  2589 |         var publicIp = ToString(args[0]);
  2590 |         var privateIp = ToString(args[1]);
  2591 |         var fallbackIp = ToString(args[2]);
  2592 |         var resolved = DotaGcRuntimeServices.GameServerConnectIpsResolver?.Invoke(
  2593 |             _context.ClientIp,
  2594 |             publicIp,
  2595 |             privateIp,
  2596 |             fallbackIp);
  2597 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(resolved))
  2598 |         {
  2599 |             resolved = BuildDefaultConnectIps(publicIp, privateIp, fallbackIp);
  2600 |         }
  2601 | 
  2602 |         return TsValue.FromString(resolved);
  2603 |     }
  2604 | 
  2605 |     private static string BuildDefaultConnectIps(string publicIp, string privateIp, string fallbackIp)
  2606 |     {
  2607 |         var ordered = new List<string>();
  2608 |         void Add(string value)
  2609 |         {
  2610 |             var trimmed = (value ?? string.Empty).Trim();
  2611 |             if (trimmed.Length == 0 || ordered.Contains(trimmed, StringComparer.Ordinal))
  2612 |             {
  2613 |                 return;
  2614 |             }
  2615 | 
  2616 |             ordered.Add(trimmed);
  2617 |         }
  2618 | 
  2619 |         Add(publicIp);
  2620 |         Add(privateIp);
  2621 |         Add(fallbackIp);
  2622 |         if (ordered.Count == 0)
  2623 |         {
  2624 |             ordered.Add("127.0.0.1");
  2625 |         }
  2626 | 
  2627 |         return string.Join(' ', ordered.Take(2));
  2628 |     }

  2677 |     private static ulong ResolveStoredDotaItemDefIndex(ulong steamId, ulong itemId)
  2678 |     {
  2679 |         if (itemId == 0)
  2680 |         {
  2681 |             return 0;
  2682 |         }
  2683 | 
  2684 |         var inventory = DotaGcRuntimeServices.InventoryProvider?.Invoke(steamId);
  2685 |         if (inventory == null)
  2686 |         {
  2687 |             return itemId;
  2688 |         }
  2689 | 
  2690 |         foreach (var item in inventory.Items.Concat(inventory.OwnedItems))
  2691 |         {
  2692 |             if (item.DefIndex == itemId)
  2693 |             {
  2694 |                 return item.DefIndex;
  2695 |             }
  2696 | 
  2697 |             if (BuildDotaItemInstanceId(steamId, item.DefIndex) == itemId)
  2698 |             {
  2699 |                 return item.DefIndex;
  2700 |             }
  2701 |         }
  2702 | 
  2703 |         return itemId <= uint.MaxValue ? itemId : 0;
  2704 |     }
  2705 | 
  2706 |     private static ulong? ResolveOwnedDotaItemDefIndex(ulong steamId, ulong itemId)
  2707 |     {
  2708 |         if (itemId == 0)
  2709 |         {
  2710 |             return null;
  2711 |         }
  2712 | 
  2713 |         var inventory = DotaGcRuntimeServices.InventoryProvider?.Invoke(steamId);
  2714 |         if (inventory == null)
  2715 |         {
  2716 |             return itemId <= uint.MaxValue ? itemId : null;
  2717 |         }
  2718 | 
  2719 |         // The profile update protobuf carries an econ item instance id. The
  2720 |         // legacy GC accepts it only if it belongs to the caller, then persists
  2721 |         // the item's defIndex so future profile responses can rebuild the full
  2722 |         // CSOEconItem from the current inventory.
  2723 |         foreach (var item in inventory.Items.Concat(inventory.OwnedItems))
  2724 |         {
  2725 |             if (item.DefIndex == itemId || BuildDotaItemInstanceId(steamId, item.DefIndex) == itemId)
  2726 |             {
  2727 |                 return item.DefIndex;
  2728 |             }
  2729 |         }
  2730 | 
  2731 |         return null;
  2732 |     }
  2733 | 
  2734 |     private static ulong BuildDotaItemInstanceId(ulong steamId, uint defIndex)
  2735 |     {
  2736 |         var accountBits = steamId & 0xffffffffUL;
  2737 |         return 0x7000000000000000UL | (accountBits << 20) | defIndex;
  2738 |     }

  2754 |     // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_DEDICATED_HOST_EXCHANGE_V1
  2755 | 
  2756 |     // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_10025_HOST_V1
  2757 |     //
  2758 |     // Parse the current request directly in C# so lobby_id remains a
  2759 |     // lossless ulong. The TypeSharp side only receives lobbyId as string.
  2760 |     //

  2763 |     //   2 -> ELobbyServerState server_state
  2764 |     //   3 -> bool safe_to_abandon
  2765 |     public TsValue DeadlockUpdateCurrentLobbyServerState()
  2766 |     {
  2767 |         if (
  2768 |             _request.MessageType !=
  2769 |             10025

  2771 |         {

  2827 |                 0,
  2828 |                 0,
  2829 |                 false,

  2832 |         }

  2834 |         var offset =
  2835 |             0;
  2836 | 
  2837 |         ulong lobbyId =
  2838 |             0;
  2839 | 
  2840 |         uint serverState =
  2841 |             0;
  2842 |

  2844 |             false;
  2845 |

  2874 |                         key >>

  2880 |                 unchecked(
  2881 |                     (int)(
  2882 |                         key &
  2883 |                         7
  2884 |                     )
  2885 |                 );

  2888 |                 fieldNumber <=
  2889 |                 0

  2893 |                     false,
  2894 |                     lobbyId,
  2895 |                     0,
  2896 |                     safeToAbandon,
  2897 |                     "invalid_field_number"
  2898 |                 );
  2899 |             }
  2900 | 
  2901 |             if (
  2902 |                 fieldNumber ==
  2903 |                     1 ||
  2904 |                 fieldNumber ==
  2905 |                     2 ||
  2906 |                 fieldNumber ==
  2907 |                     3
  2908 |             )

  2910 |                 if (
  2911 |                     wireType !=
  2912 |                     0

  2914 |                 {

  2999 |                     lobbyId,
  3000 |                     0,

  3018 |                 "missing_lobby_id"

  3021 | 
  3022 |         /*
  3023 |          * Current ELobbyServerState values used by Deadlock:
  3024 |          *

  3026 |          *   1 InGame
  3027 |          *   2 PostMatch
  3028 |          *   3 SignedOut
  3029 |          *   4 Abandoned

  3032 |             serverState >

  3042 |             return BuildDeadlock10025Result(

  3052 |             DeadlockGcRuntimeServices

  3082 |                 _context.SteamId,

  3116 |         DeadlockGcRuntimeServices

  3216 |     private static string Deadlock10025StateName(
  3217 |         uint serverState)
  3218 |     {
  3219 |         return serverState switch
  3220 |         {
  3221 |             0 => "Assign",
  3222 |             1 => "InGame",
  3223 |             2 => "PostMatch",

  3226 |             _ => "Unknown"

  3230 |     private static bool TryReadDeadlock10025VarUInt64(
  3231 |         byte[] payload,
  3232 |         ref int offset,
  3233 |         out ulong value)
  3234 |     {
  3235 |         value =
  3236 |             0;
  3237 | 
  3238 |         for (
  3239 |             var i = 0;
  3240 |             i < 10;
  3241 |             i++
  3242 |         )
  3243 |         {
  3244 |             if (
  3245 |                 offset >=
  3246 |                 payload.Length
  3247 |             )
  3248 |             {
  3249 |                 return false;
  3250 |             }
  3251 | 
  3252 |             var current =
  3253 |                 payload[
  3254 |                     offset++
  3255 |                 ];
  3256 | 
  3257 |             var low =
  3258 |                 unchecked(
  3259 |                     (ulong)(
  3260 |                         current &
  3261 |                         0x7f
  3262 |                     )
  3263 |                 );
  3264 | 
  3265 |             /*
  3266 |              * A uint64 varint may use at most one payload bit
  3267 |              * in its tenth byte.
  3268 |              */
  3269 |             if (
  3270 |                 i ==
  3271 |                     9 &&
  3272 |                 low >
  3273 |                     1
  3274 |             )
  3275 |             {
  3276 |                 return false;
  3277 |             }
  3278 | 
  3279 |             value |=
  3280 |                 low <<
  3281 |                 (
  3282 |                     i *
  3283 |                     7
  3284 |                 );
  3285 | 
  3286 |             if (
  3287 |                 (
  3288 |                     current &
  3289 |                     0x80
  3290 |                 ) ==
  3291 |                 0
  3292 |             )
  3293 |             {
  3294 |                 return true;
  3295 |             }
  3296 |         }
  3297 | 
  3298 |         return false;
  3299 |     }
  3300 | 
  3301 |     private static bool TrySkipDeadlock10025Field(
  3302 |         byte[] payload,
  3303 |         ref int offset,
  3304 |         int wireType)
  3305 |     {
  3306 |         switch (
  3307 |             wireType
  3308 |         )
  3309 |         {
  3310 |             case 0:
  3311 |             {
  3312 |                 return TryReadDeadlock10025VarUInt64(
  3313 |                     payload,
  3314 |                     ref offset,
  3315 |                     out _
  3316 |                 );
  3317 |             }
  3318 | 
  3319 |             case 1:
  3320 |             {
  3321 |                 if (
  3322 |                     offset >
  3323 |                     payload.Length -
  3324 |                     8
  3325 |                 )
  3326 |                 {
  3327 |                     return false;
  3328 |                 }
  3329 | 
  3330 |                 offset +=
  3331 |                     8;
  3332 | 
  3333 |                 return true;
  3334 |             }
  3335 | 
  3336 |             case 2:
  3337 |             {
  3338 |                 if (
  3339 |                     !TryReadDeadlock10025VarUInt64(
  3340 |                         payload,
  3341 |                         ref offset,
  3342 |                         out var length
  3343 |                     )
  3344 |                 )
  3345 |                 {
  3346 |                     return false;
  3347 |                 }
  3348 | 
  3349 |                 var remaining =
  3350 |                     payload.Length -
  3351 |                     offset;
  3352 | 
  3353 |                 if (
  3354 |                     length >
  3355 |                     unchecked(
  3356 |                         (ulong)remaining
  3357 |                     )
  3358 |                 )
  3359 |                 {
  3360 |                     return false;
  3361 |                 }
  3362 | 
  3363 |                 offset +=
  3364 |                     unchecked(
  3365 |                         (int)length
  3366 |                     );
  3367 | 
  3368 |                 return true;
  3369 |             }
  3370 | 
  3371 |             case 5:
  3372 |             {
  3373 |                 if (
  3374 |                     offset >
  3375 |                     payload.Length -
  3376 |                     4
  3377 |                 )
  3378 |                 {
  3379 |                     return false;
  3380 |                 }
  3381 | 
  3382 |                 offset +=
  3383 |                     4;
  3384 | 
  3385 |                 return true;
  3386 |             }
  3387 | 
  3388 |             default:
  3389 |             {
  3390 |                 /*
  3391 |                  * Groups (wire 3/4) are not expected here.
  3392 |                  * Reject rather than trying to guess.
  3393 |                  */
  3394 |                 return false;
  3395 |             }
  3396 |         }
  3397 |     }

  3400 |     public TsValue DeadlockStartDedicatedServer(
  3401 |         TsValue[] args)
  3402 |     {
  3403 |         if (
  3404 |             args.Length <
  3405 |             1

  3407 |         {
  3408 |             throw new InvalidOperationException(
  3409 |                 "deadlockStartDedicatedServer(lobbyId, map?) requires lobbyId"

  3412 | 
  3413 |         var lobbyId =
  3414 |             Convert.ToUInt64(

  3672 |     public TsValue DeadlockInspectCurrentMatchSignout()
  3673 |     {
  3674 |         static bool TryReadVarUInt64(
  3675 |             byte[] data,
  3676 |             ref int offset,
  3677 |             out ulong value)
  3678 |         {
  3679 |             value =
  3680 |                 0;
  3681 | 
  3682 |             for (
  3683 |                 var index = 0;
  3684 |                 index < 10;
  3685 |                 index++
  3686 |             )
  3687 |             {
  3688 |                 if (
  3689 |                     offset >=
  3690 |                     data.Length
  3691 |                 )
  3692 |                 {
  3693 |                     return false;
  3694 |                 }
  3695 | 
  3696 |                 var current =
  3697 |                     data[
  3698 |                         offset++
  3699 |                     ];
  3700 | 
  3701 |                 var low =
  3702 |                     unchecked(
  3703 |                         (ulong)(
  3704 |                             current &
  3705 |                             0x7f
  3706 |                         )
  3707 |                     );
  3708 | 
  3709 |                 if (
  3710 |                     index ==
  3711 |                         9 &&
  3712 |                     low >
  3713 |                         1
  3714 |                 )
  3715 |                 {
  3716 |                     return false;
  3717 |                 }
  3718 | 
  3719 |                 value |=
  3720 |                     low <<
  3721 |                     (
  3722 |                         index *
  3723 |                         7
  3724 |                     );
  3725 | 
  3726 |                 if (
  3727 |                     (
  3728 |                         current &
  3729 |                         0x80
  3730 |                     ) ==
  3731 |                     0
  3732 |                 )
  3733 |                 {
  3734 |                     return true;
  3735 |                 }
  3736 |             }
  3737 | 
  3738 |             return false;
  3739 |         }
  3740 | 
  3741 |         static bool TryReadLengthDelimited(
  3742 |             byte[] data,
  3743 |             ref int offset,
  3744 |             out byte[] value)
  3745 |         {
  3746 |             value =
  3747 |                 Array.Empty<byte>();
  3748 | 
  3749 |             if (
  3750 |                 !TryReadVarUInt64(
  3751 |                     data,
  3752 |                     ref offset,
  3753 |                     out var rawLength
  3754 |                 )
  3755 |             )
  3756 |             {
  3757 |                 return false;
  3758 |             }
  3759 | 
  3760 |             if (
  3761 |                 rawLength >
  3762 |                 int.MaxValue
  3763 |             )
  3764 |             {
  3765 |                 return false;
  3766 |             }
  3767 | 
  3768 |             var length =
  3769 |                 unchecked(
  3770 |                     (int)rawLength
  3771 |                 );
  3772 | 
  3773 |             if (
  3774 |                 length <
  3775 |                     0 ||
  3776 |                 offset >
  3777 |                     data.Length -
  3778 |                     length
  3779 |             )
  3780 |             {
  3781 |                 return false;
  3782 |             }
  3783 | 
  3784 |             value =
  3785 |                 new byte[
  3786 |                     length
  3787 |                 ];

  3789 |             if (
  3790 |                 length >
  3791 |                 0

  3794 |                 Buffer.BlockCopy(
  3795 |                     data,
  3796 |                     offset,
  3797 |                     value,
  3798 |                     0,
  3799 |                     length
  3800 |                 );
  3801 |             }
  3802 | 
  3803 |             offset +=
  3804 |                 length;
  3805 | 
  3806 |             return true;
  3807 |         }
  3808 | 
  3809 |         static bool TrySkipField(
  3810 |             byte[] data,
  3811 |             ref int offset,

  3813 |         {

  5660 |     // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_POST_SIGNOUT_DELAYED_RELEASE_V1_METHOD
  5661 |     //
  5662 |     // IMPORTANT:
  5663 |     // reply(10015) only queues the HTTP response packet. Killing the
  5664 |     // requester synchronously from the same exchange can prevent the
  5665 |     // dedicated from ever receiving that response.
  5666 |     //
  5667 |     // This host therefore:
  5668 |     //   1. verifies the request is 10014;
  5669 |     //   2. verifies the sender is a Supervisor-owned dedicated;
  5670 |     //   3. extracts lobby_id (protobuf field 3) from BodyBase64;
  5671 |     //   4. verifies lobby -> GameServer SteamID ownership;
  5672 |     //   5. schedules Supervisor.Release only after a short delay.
  5673 |     //
  5674 |     public TsValue DeadlockScheduleCurrentMatchSignoutRelease(
  5675 |         TsValue[] args)
  5676 |     {
  5677 |         static bool TryReadVarint(
  5678 |             byte[] data,
  5679 |             ref int offset,
  5680 |             out ulong value)
  5681 |         {
  5682 |             value = 0;
  5683 | 
  5684 |             var shift =
  5685 |                 0;
  5686 | 
  5687 |             while (
  5688 |                 offset <
  5689 |                 data.Length &&
  5690 |                 shift <=
  5691 |                 63
  5692 |             )
  5693 |             {
  5694 |                 var current =
  5695 |                     data[
  5696 |                         offset++
  5697 |                     ];

  5699 |                 if (
  5700 |                     shift ==
  5701 |                     63 &&

  5704 |                         0xFE
  5705 |                     ) !=
  5706 |                     0

  5709 |                     return false;

  5712 |                 value |=
  5713 |                     (
  5714 |                         (ulong)(
  5715 |                             current &
  5716 |                             0x7F
  5717 |                         )

  5720 |                     shift;

  5723 |                     (
  5724 |                         current &
  5725 |                         0x80
  5726 |                     ) ==
  5727 |                     0

  5729 |                 {
  5730 |                     return true;
  5731 |                 }
  5732 | 
  5733 |                 shift +=
  5734 |                     7;
  5735 |             }
  5736 | 
  5737 |             return false;
  5738 |         }
  5739 | 
  5740 |         static bool TryReadLobbyId(
  5741 |             byte[] data,
  5742 |             out ulong lobbyId)
  5743 |         {
  5744 |             lobbyId =
  5745 |                 0;

  5747 |             var offset =
  5748 |                 0;
  5749 | 
  5750 |             while (

  5754 |             {
  5755 |                 if (
  5756 |                     !TryReadVarint(

  5780 |                     0

  5792 |                     fieldNumber ==
  5793 |                     3 &&
  5794 |                     wireType ==

  5805 |                 switch (

  5810 |                     {
  5811 |                         if (

  5813 |                                 data,
  5814 |                                 ref offset,
  5815 |                                 out _
  5816 |                             )

  5898 | 
  5899 |         if (
  5900 |             _request.MessageType !=
  5901 |             10014

  5918 |         if (

  7786 |     private DotaStatsProfile GetStatsProfile(uint accountId)
  7787 |     {
  7788 |         var store = DotaGcRuntimeServices.StatsStore;
  7789 |         return store == null
  7790 |             ? DefaultProfile(accountId)
  7791 |             : accountId == _context.AccountId
  7792 |                 ? store.EnsureProfile(_context.SteamId, _context.AccountId, _context.PersonaName)
  7793 |                 : store.GetProfile(accountId);
  7794 |     }

  7796 |     private TsValue ToTsProfileSnapshot(uint requestedAccountId)
  7797 |     {
  7798 |         var store = DotaGcRuntimeServices.StatsStore;
  7799 |         var profile = store == null
  7800 |             ? DefaultProfile(requestedAccountId)
  7801 |             : requestedAccountId == _context.AccountId
  7802 |                 ? store.EnsureProfile(_context.SteamId, _context.AccountId, _context.PersonaName)
  7803 |                 : store.GetProfile(requestedAccountId);
  7804 | 
  7805 |         var global = store?.GetGlobalStats(profile.AccountId) ?? new DotaStatsGlobalStats { AccountId = profile.AccountId };
  7806 |         var conduct = store?.GetConduct(profile.AccountId) ?? new DotaStatsConduct { AccountId = profile.AccountId };
  7807 |         var value = new TsObject("DotaProfileSnapshot");
  7808 |         value.SetField("accountId", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.AccountId)));
  7809 |         value.SetField("steamId", TsValue.FromUInt64(profile.SteamId));
  7810 |         value.SetField("personaName", TsValue.FromString(profile.PersonaName ?? string.Empty));
  7811 |         value.SetField(
  7812 |             "backgroundItemDefIndex",
  7813 |             TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)ResolveStoredDotaItemDefIndex(profile.SteamId, profile.BackgroundItemId))));
  7814 |         value.SetField("rankTier", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.RankTier)));
  7815 |         value.SetField("rankTierScore", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.RankTierScore)));
  7816 |         value.SetField("leaderboardRank", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.LeaderboardRank)));
  7817 |         value.SetField("badgePoints", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.BadgePoints)));
  7818 |         value.SetField("eventPoints", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.EventPoints)));
  7819 |         value.SetField("activeEventId", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)DotaActiveEventId)));
  7820 |         value.SetField("lifetimeGames", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.LifetimeGames)));
  7821 |         value.SetField("level", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)profile.Level)));
  7822 |         value.SetField("isPlusSubscriber", TsValue.FromBool(false));
  7823 |         value.SetField("plusOriginalStartDate", TsValue.FromInt32(0));
  7824 |         value.SetField("firstMatchTime", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)(store?.GetFirstMatchTime(profile.AccountId) ?? 0))));
  7825 |         value.SetField("mvpCount", TsValue.FromInt32(unchecked((int)(store?.GetMvpCount(profile.AccountId) ?? 0))));
  7826 |         value.SetField("globalStats", ToTsGlobalStats(global));
  7827 |         value.SetField("conduct", ToTsConduct(conduct));
  7828 |         value.SetField("slots", ToTsProfileSlots(store?.GetProfileSlots(profile.AccountId) ?? Array.Empty<DotaStatsProfileSlot>()));
  7829 |         value.SetField("heroes", ToTsHeroStats(store?.GetHeroStandings(profile.AccountId) ?? Array.Empty<DotaStatsHeroStats>()));
  7830 |         value.SetField("trophies", ToTsTrophies(store?.GetTrophies(profile.AccountId) ?? Array.Empty<DotaStatsTrophy>()));
  7831 |         value.SetField("featuredHeroIds", ToTsUInt32Array(store?.GetFeaturedHeroes(profile.AccountId) ?? Array.Empty<uint>()));
  7832 |         value.SetField("recentMatches", ToTsRecentMatches(store?.GetRecentMatches(profile.AccountId, 8) ?? Array.Empty<DotaStatsMatchPlayer>()));
  7833 |         value.SetField("allHeroProgress", ToTsAllHeroProgress(store?.GetAllHeroProgress(profile.AccountId) ?? DefaultAllHeroProgress(profile.AccountId, profile.PersonaName ?? string.Empty)));
  7834 |         return new TsObjectValue(value);

  8667 |     private static TsValue ToTsDotaTeamMembers(JsonElement row)

  8762 |     private static string JsonString(JsonElement element, string propertyName, string defaultValue)
  8763 |     {
  8764 |         return element.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.Object &&
  8765 |                element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out var property) &&
  8766 |                property.ValueKind == JsonValueKind.String
  8767 |             ? property.GetString() ?? defaultValue
  8768 |             : defaultValue;
  8769 |     }
  8770 | 
  8771 |     private static uint JsonUInt32(JsonElement element, string propertyName, uint defaultValue)
  8772 |     {
  8773 |         if (element.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out var property))
  8774 |         {
  8775 |             return defaultValue;
  8776 |         }
  8777 | 
  8778 |         return property.ValueKind switch
  8779 |         {
  8780 |             JsonValueKind.Number when property.TryGetUInt32(out var number) => number,
  8781 |             JsonValueKind.String when uint.TryParse(property.GetString(), out var number) => number,
  8782 |             _ => defaultValue
  8783 |         };
  8784 |     }
  8785 | 
  8786 |     private static ulong JsonUInt64(JsonElement element, string propertyName, ulong defaultValue)
  8787 |     {
  8788 |         if (element.ValueKind != JsonValueKind.Object || !element.TryGetProperty(propertyName, out var property))
  8789 |         {
  8790 |             return defaultValue;
  8791 |         }
  8792 | 
  8793 |         return property.ValueKind switch
  8794 |         {
  8795 |             JsonValueKind.Number when property.TryGetUInt64(out var number) => number,
  8796 |             JsonValueKind.String when ulong.TryParse(property.GetString(), out var number) => number,
  8797 |             _ => defaultValue
  8798 |         };
  8799 |     }

  8812 |             RegionPings = UInt32ArrayField(obj, "regionPings", path),

  8814 |         };
  8815 |     }

  8817 |     private static uint PartyInviteCutoff()
  8818 |     {
  8819 |         const uint partyInviteLifetimeSeconds = 600;
  8820 |         var now = (uint)DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeSeconds();
  8821 |         return now > partyInviteLifetimeSeconds ? now - partyInviteLifetimeSeconds : 0;
  8822 |     }

  8824 |     private static TsValue ToTsUInt32Array(IEnumerable<uint> values)
  8825 |     {

  8834 |

  8893 |     private static uint U32Field(TsObject value, string fieldName, string path, uint defaultValue = 0)
  8894 |     {
  8895 |         var field = value.GetField(fieldName);
  8896 |         if (field is TsNull or TsVoid)
  8897 |         {
  8898 |             return defaultValue;
  8899 |         }
  8900 | 
  8901 |         var fieldPath = $"{path}.{fieldName}";
  8902 |         return CheckedToUInt32(ToNumber(field, fieldPath), fieldPath);
  8903 |     }
  8904 | 
  8905 |     // Convert.ToUInt32(double) throws a bare OverflowException with no indication of
  8906 |     // which field or value caused it. Validate the range ourselves so an out-of-range
  8907 |     // realtime stat (e.g. a negative value meant for a signed field) reports exactly
  8908 |     // where it came from instead of crashing the whole GC request opaquely.
  8909 |     private static uint CheckedToUInt32(double value, string path)
  8910 |     {
  8911 |         if (double.IsNaN(value) || value < uint.MinValue || value > uint.MaxValue)
  8912 |         {
  8913 |             throw new InvalidOperationException($"{path}: value {value} is outside UInt32 range");
  8914 |         }
  8915 | 
  8916 |         return Convert.ToUInt32(value);
  8917 |     }
  8918 |

  8923 |             ? defaultValue
  8924 |             : Convert.ToUInt64(ToInteger(field, $"{path}.{fieldName}").ToString());

  9056 |     private static byte[] ToBytes(TsValue value, string path = "value")
  9057 |     {
  9058 |         if (value is TsStringValue stringValue)
  9059 |         {
  9060 |             return Convert.FromBase64String(stringValue.Value);
  9061 |         }
  9062 | 
  9063 |         if (value is TsUint8ArrayValue bytesValue)
  9064 |         {
  9065 |             var copy = new byte[bytesValue.Length];
  9066 |             Array.Copy(bytesValue.Value, copy, copy.Length);
  9067 |             return copy;
  9068 |         }
  9069 | 
  9070 |         if (value is not TsArrayValue arrayValue)
  9071 |         {
  9072 |             throw new InvalidOperationException($"{path}: expected Uint8Array, byte array, or base64 string; got {value.ValueType}");
  9073 |         }
  9074 | 
  9075 |         var bytes = new byte[arrayValue.Value.Count];
  9076 |         for (var i = 0; i < bytes.Length; i++)
  9077 |         {
  9078 |             bytes[i] = Convert.ToByte(ToNumber(arrayValue.Value.Get(i), $"{path}[{i}]"));
  9079 |         }
  9080 | 
  9081 |         return bytes;
  9082 |     }

  9089 |     private static double ToNumber(TsValue value, string path = "value")
  9090 |     {
  9091 |         return value switch
  9092 |         {
  9093 |             TsInt32Value int32Value => int32Value.Value,
  9094 |             TsInt64Value int64Value => int64Value.Value,
  9095 |             TsUInt64Value uint64Value => uint64Value.Value,
  9096 |             TsFloat32Value float32Value => float32Value.Value,
  9097 |             TsFloat64Value float64Value => float64Value.Value,
  9098 |             TsDecimalValue decimalValue => (double)decimalValue.Value,
  9099 |             TsStringValue stringValue when double.TryParse(stringValue.Value, out var parsed) => parsed,
  9100 |             _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{path}: expected numeric value, got {value.ValueType}")
  9101 |         };
  9102 |     }
  9103 |

  9110 |             TsInt64Value int64Value => int64Value.Value != 0,
  9111 |             TsUInt64Value uint64Value => uint64Value.Value != 0,
  9112 |             _ => throw new InvalidOperationException($"{path}: expected boolean value, got {value.ValueType}")
  9113 |         };
  9114 |     }

   156 |             lobbyId

   469 |     public void ObserveRegistration(
   470 |         ulong gameServerSteamId,
   471 |         ApiGameServer server)
   472 |     {
   473 |         if (
   474 |             gameServerSteamId ==
   475 |                 0 ||
   476 |             server ==
   477 |                 null ||
   478 |             server.Port <=
   479 |                 0 ||
   480 |             !server.Dedicated
   481 |         )
   482 |         {
   483 |             return;

   487 |         // the port is one of OUR reservations. Explicit foreign AppIDs

   491 |                 0 &&
   492 |             server.AppId !=
   493 |                 DeadlockGcRuntimeServices.AppId
   494 |         )
   495 |         {
   496 |             return;

   499 |         lock (
   500 |             _sync

   502 |         {
   503 |             SweepLocked(
   504 |                 DateTime.UtcNow

   507 |             var reservation =
   508 |                 _reservations.Values.FirstOrDefault(
   509 |                     candidate =>
   510 |                         candidate.IsLive &&
   511 |                         candidate.Port ==
   512 |                             server.Port &&
   513 |                         (
   514 |                             candidate.State ==
   515 |                                 DedicatedReservationState.Starting ||
   516 |                             candidate.State ==
   517 |                                 DedicatedReservationState.Registered
   518 |                         )
   519 |                 );
   520 | 
   521 |             if (
   522 |                 reservation ==
   523 |                 null
   524 |             )
   525 |             {
   526 |                 return;
   527 |             }
   528 | 
   529 |             reservation.GameServerSteamId =
   530 |                 gameServerSteamId;
   531 | 
   532 |             reservation.PublicIp =
   533 |                 server.IP;
   534 | 
   535 |             reservation.State =
   536 |                 DedicatedReservationState.Registered;
   537 | 
   538 |             _logger.LogInformation(
   539 |                 "Deadlock dedicated registered SteamID {SteamId} for lobby {LobbyId} at {Ip}:{Port}",
   540 |                 gameServerSteamId,

   542 |                 reservation.PublicIp,

   797 |     private void SweepLocked(
   798 |         DateTime current)
   799 |     {
   800 |         foreach (
   801 |             var reservation in

   824 |                     )

   826 |

   830 |             if (

   833 |                 current -

   853 |             }
   854 |         }
   855 |     }

   857 |     private int AllocatePortLocked()
   858 |     {
   859 |         for (
   860 |             var port =
   861 |                 _portStart;
   862 | 
   863 |             port <=
   864 |                 Math.Min(

   876 |                         reservation.IsLive &&
   877 |                         reservation.Port ==

   890 |             {

   935 |     private void StopProcess(
   936 |         DedicatedReservation reservation,
   937 |         string reason)
   938 |     {
   939 |         if (
   940 |             reservation.State !=
   941 |             DedicatedReservationState.Failed
   942 |         )
   943 |         {
   944 |             reservation.State =
   945 |                 DedicatedReservationState.Stopped;
   946 |         }
   947 | 
   948 |         try
   949 |         {
   950 |             if (
   951 |                 !reservation.Process.HasExited
   952 |             )
   953 |             {
   954 |                 reservation.Process.Kill(
   955 |                     entireProcessTree:
   956 |                         true
   957 |                 );
   958 | 
   959 |                 _logger.LogInformation(
   960 |                     "Stopped Deadlock dedicated pid {ProcessId} lobby {LobbyId}: {Reason}",
   961 |                     reservation.Process.Id,
   962 |                     reservation.LobbyId,
   963 |                     reason
   964 |                 );
   965 |             }
   966 |         }
   967 |         catch (
   968 |             InvalidOperationException
   969 |         )
   970 |         {
   971 |         }
   972 |         catch (
   973 |             Exception ex
   974 |         )
   975 |         {
   976 |             _logger.LogWarning(
   977 |                 ex,
   978 |                 "Could not stop Deadlock dedicated lobby {LobbyId}",
   979 |                 reservation.LobbyId
   980 |             );
   981 |         }
   982 |     }

   984 |     private static string ResolvePath(
   985 |         string? configured,
   986 |         string contentRoot,
   987 |         string fallback)
   988 |     {
   989 |         var value =
   990 |             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
   991 |                 configured
   992 |             )
   993 |                 ? fallback
   994 |                 : configured.Trim();

   996 |         return Path.GetFullPath(
   997 |             Path.IsPathRooted(
   998 |                 value
   999 |             )
  1000 |                 ? value
  1001 |                 : Path.Combine(
  1002 |                     contentRoot,
  1003 |                     value
  1004 |                 )
  1005 |         );
  1006 |     }

  1033 |     private static string NormalizeMap(
  1034 |         string? requested,
  1035 |         string fallback)
  1036 |     {
  1037 |         var map =
  1038 |             string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(
  1039 |                 requested
  1040 |             )
  1041 |                 ? fallback
  1042 |                 : requested.Trim();

  1044 |         if (

  1073 |                 character !=
  1074 |                     '-' &&
  1075 |                 character !=

    52 |     public DedicatedLaunchResult Start(ulong lobbyId, string? requestedMap)
    53 |     {
    54 |         if (lobbyId == 0)
    55 |         {
    56 |             return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("Lobby id is required.");
    57 |         }
    58 | 
    59 |         // Read the live settings once per launch so an admin edit takes effect on
    60 |         // the next dedicated server without a restart.
    61 |         var settings = _settings.Current;
    62 | 
    63 |         lock (_sync)
    64 |         {
    65 |             SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);
    66 |             if (_reservations.TryGetValue(lobbyId, out var existing) && existing.IsLive)
    67 |             {
    68 |                 return new DedicatedLaunchResult(true, existing.Port, existing.State, string.Empty);
    69 |             }
    70 | 
    71 |             if (!settings.DedicatedEnabled)
    72 |             {
    73 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("Dedicated servers are disabled by configuration.");
    74 |             }
    75 | 
    76 |             if (!File.Exists(_executablePath))
    77 |             {
    78 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated executable was not found at '{_executablePath}'.");
    79 |             }
    80 | 
    81 |             if (!Directory.Exists(_workingDirectory))
    82 |             {
    83 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated working directory was not found at '{_workingDirectory}'.");
    84 |             }
    85 | 
    86 |             if (!File.Exists(_payloadDllPath))
    87 |             {
    88 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated emulator payload was not found at '{_payloadDllPath}'.");
    89 |             }
    90 | 
    91 |             var port = AllocatePortLocked(settings.DedicatedPortStart);
    92 |             if (port == 0)
    93 |             {
    94 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("No available UDP/TCP port was found for a dedicated server.");
    95 |             }
    96 | 
    97 |             var map = NormalizeMap(requestedMap);
    98 |             var arguments = new List<string>
    99 |             {
   100 |                 "-dedicated"
   101 |             };
   102 |             // Always insecure: the emulator cannot produce a valid VAC session, so a
   103 |             // "secure" dedicated only ever yields the client VAC popup/block. Passing
   104 |             // -insecure keeps dota2 from loading the VAC module at all.
   105 |             arguments.Add("-insecure");
   106 |             // Bind explicitly. Recent Dota dedicated builds can otherwise pick a
   107 |             // single interface, leaving advertised endpoints black-holed.
   108 |             if (TryNormalizeIPv4(settings.DedicatedBindIp, out var bindIp))
   109 |             {
   110 |                 arguments.Add("-ip");
   111 |                 arguments.Add(bindIp);
   112 |             }
   113 |             arguments.Add("-port");
   114 |             arguments.Add(port.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
   115 |             arguments.Add("+tv_port");
   116 |             arguments.Add((port + _tvPortOffset).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
   117 |             arguments.Add("+sv_lan");
   118 |             arguments.Add("0");
   119 |             // Generous netchannel timeout. A peer with a weaker CPU or missing
   120 |             // cosmetic assets can stall the client for 10-20s during the hero-select
   121 |             // loadout (EconItemSearch / UGC image resolution), going silent on the
   122 |             // wire; the default ~20s server timeout then drops it mid-load. Real
   123 |             // matchmaking is lenient during loading, so widen the window.
   124 |             arguments.Add("+cl_timeout");
   125 |             arguments.Add("120");
   126 |             arguments.Add("+map");
   127 |             arguments.Add(map);
   128 |             arguments.Add("-console");
   129 |             arguments.Add("-vconsole");
   130 |             arguments.Add("-novid");
   131 | 
   132 |             var environmentVariables = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   133 |             {
   134 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_LOBBY_ID"] = lobbyId.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
   135 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_PORT"] = port.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
   136 |                 ["SKYNET_PROCESS_ROLE"] = "dedicated",
   137 |                 ["SKYNET_LOG_SUFFIX"] = $"dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}",
   138 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_INSECURE"] = "1"
   139 |             };
   140 | 
   141 |             try
   142 |             {
   143 |                 Directory.CreateDirectory(_diagnosticsDirectory);
   144 |                 var outputPath = Path.Combine(_diagnosticsDirectory, $"dota_dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}_stdout.log");
   145 |                 var errorPath = Path.Combine(_diagnosticsDirectory, $"dota_dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}_stderr.log");
   146 |                 // The dedicated process is injected before it runs so it uses the
   147 |                 // launcher's payload DLL, not any stale steam_api64.dll beside Dota.
   148 |                 // steam_api resolves its ini and SKYNET logs from Dota's exe folder,
   149 |                 // while the executable bytes remain untouched on disk.
   150 |                 var process = InjectedProcessLauncher.Launch(
   151 |                     _executablePath,
   152 |                     _payloadDllPath,
   153 |                     arguments,
   154 |                     _workingDirectory,
   155 |                     environmentVariables,
   156 |                     _showWindow);
   157 |                 File.WriteAllText(outputPath, $"Launched through payload injection: {_payloadDllPath}{Environment.NewLine}");
   158 |                 File.WriteAllText(errorPath, string.Empty);
   159 | 
   160 |                 var reservation = new DedicatedReservation(lobbyId, port, map, process, DateTime.UtcNow);
   161 |                 _reservations[lobbyId] = reservation;
   162 |                 _logger.LogInformation(
   163 |                     "Started Dota dedicated server pid {ProcessId} for lobby {LobbyId} on port {Port} map {Map}. Payload: {Payload}. Args: {Arguments}. Stdout: {StdoutPath}. Stderr: {StderrPath}",
   164 |                     process.Id, lobbyId, port, map, _payloadDllPath, string.Join(" ", arguments), outputPath, errorPath);
   165 |                 return new DedicatedLaunchResult(true, port, reservation.State, string.Empty);
   166 |             }
   167 |             catch (Exception ex)
   168 |             {
   169 |                 _logger.LogError(ex, "Could not start Dota dedicated server for lobby {LobbyId}", lobbyId);
   170 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed(ex.Message);
   171 |             }
   172 |         }
   173 |     }

   175 |     // GCGameServerInfo is the authoritative point at which a server identity
   176 |     // becomes usable. Match on the reserved game port, never on arrival order.
   177 |     public string ClaimLobby(ulong gameServerSteamId, uint reportedPort)
   178 |     {
   179 |         if (gameServerSteamId == 0 || reportedPort == 0)
   180 |         {
   181 |             return "0";
   182 |         }
   183 | 
   184 |         lock (_sync)
   185 |         {
   186 |             SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);
   187 |             foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
   188 |             {
   189 |                 if (reservation.GameServerSteamId == gameServerSteamId)
   190 |                 {
   191 |                     return reservation.LobbyId.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   192 |                 }
   193 | 
   194 |                 if ((reservation.State == DedicatedReservationState.Starting || reservation.State == DedicatedReservationState.Registered) &&
   195 |                     reservation.Port == reportedPort && reservation.IsLive)
   196 |                 {
   197 |                     reservation.GameServerSteamId = gameServerSteamId;
   198 |                     reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Claimed;
   199 |                     _logger.LogInformation(
   200 |                         "Claimed dedicated server {SteamId} for lobby {LobbyId} on port {Port}",
   201 |                         gameServerSteamId, reservation.LobbyId, reportedPort);
   202 |                     return reservation.LobbyId.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture);
   203 |                 }
   204 |             }
   205 | 
   206 |             _logger.LogWarning(
   207 |                 "Rejected unreserved dedicated GC server {SteamId} on port {Port}",
   208 |                 gameServerSteamId, reportedPort);
   209 |             return "0";
   210 |         }
   211 |     }

   227 |     public void ObserveRegistration(ulong gameServerSteamId, ApiGameServer server)
   228 |     {
   229 |         if (gameServerSteamId == 0 || server == null || server.Port <= 0 || !server.Dedicated)
   230 |         {

   278 |     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
   279 |     {
   280 |         using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
   281 |         try
   282 |         {
   283 |             while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
   284 |             {
   285 |                 lock (_sync)
   286 |                 {
   287 |                     SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);
   288 |                 }
   289 |             }
   290 |         }
   291 |         catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
   292 |         {
   293 |         }
   294 |     }
   295 | 
   296 |     public override Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   297 |     {
   298 |         lock (_sync)
   299 |         {
   300 |             foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
   301 |             {
   302 |                 StopProcess(reservation, "SKYNET server stopped");
   303 |             }
   304 |             _reservations.Clear();
   305 |         }
   306 | 
   307 |         return base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
   308 |     }
   309 | 
   310 |     private void SweepLocked(DateTime now)
   311 |     {
   312 |         foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
   313 |         {
   314 |             if (!reservation.IsLive && reservation.State is not DedicatedReservationState.Failed and not DedicatedReservationState.Stopped)
   315 |             {
   316 |                 reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Failed;
   317 |                 reservation.Error = "Dedicated Dota process exited before the match was ready.";
   318 |                 _logger.LogWarning(
   319 |                     "Dedicated server for lobby {LobbyId} stopped before ready. Exit code: {ExitCode}",
   320 |                     reservation.LobbyId, TryGetExitCode(reservation.Process));
   321 |             }
   322 |             else if (reservation.State == DedicatedReservationState.Starting &&
   323 |                      now - reservation.StartedAt > _startupTimeout)
   324 |             {
   325 |                 reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Failed;
   326 |                 reservation.Error = "Timed out waiting for the dedicated server GC handshake.";
   327 |                 StopProcess(reservation, reservation.Error);
   328 |                 _logger.LogWarning("Dedicated server for lobby {LobbyId} timed out waiting for GC handshake", reservation.LobbyId);
   329 |             }
   330 |         }
   331 |     }
   332 | 
   333 |     private int AllocatePortLocked(int portStart)
   334 |     {
   335 |         for (var port = portStart; port <= Math.Min(65534, portStart + 256); port++)
   336 |         {
   337 |             if (_reservations.Values.Any(reservation => reservation.IsLive && reservation.Port == port))
   338 |             {
   339 |                 continue;
   340 |             }
   341 | 
   342 |             if (CanBindPort(port))
   343 |             {
   344 |                 return port;
   345 |             }
   346 |         }
   347 | 
   348 |         return 0;
   349 |     }
   350 | 
   351 |     private static bool CanBindPort(int port)
   352 |     {
   353 |         try
   354 |         {
   355 |             using var tcp = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Any, port);
   356 |             tcp.Start();
   357 |             using var udp = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Dgram, ProtocolType.Udp);
   358 |             udp.Bind(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, port));
   359 |             return true;
   360 |         }
   361 |         catch (SocketException)
   362 |         {
   363 |             return false;
   364 |         }
   365 |     }
   366 | 
   367 |     private void StopProcess(DedicatedReservation reservation, string reason)
   368 |     {
   369 |         if (reservation.State != DedicatedReservationState.Failed)
   370 |         {
   371 |             reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Stopped;
   372 |         }
   373 | 
   374 |         try
   375 |         {
   376 |             if (!reservation.Process.HasExited)
   377 |             {
   378 |                 reservation.Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
   379 |                 _logger.LogInformation(
   380 |                     "Stopped dedicated Dota pid {ProcessId} for lobby {LobbyId}: {Reason}",
   381 |                     reservation.Process.Id, reservation.LobbyId, reason);
   382 |             }
   383 |         }
   384 |         catch (InvalidOperationException)
   385 |         {
   386 |         }
   387 |         catch (Exception ex)
   388 |         {
   389 |             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not stop dedicated Dota process for lobby {LobbyId}", reservation.LobbyId);
   390 |         }
   391 |     }
   392 | 
   393 |     private static string ResolvePath(string? configured, string contentRoot, string fallback)
   394 |     {
   395 |         var value = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured) ? fallback : configured.Trim();
   396 |         return Path.GetFullPath(Path.IsPathRooted(value) ? value : Path.Combine(contentRoot, value));
   397 |     }
   398 | 
   399 |     private static bool TryNormalizeIPv4(string value, out string normalized)
   400 |     {
   401 |         normalized = string.Empty;
   402 |         if (!IPAddress.TryParse(value, out var parsed) || parsed.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork ||
   403 |             IPAddress.IsLoopback(parsed))
   404 |         {
   405 |             return false;
   406 |         }
   407 | 
   408 |         normalized = parsed.ToString();
   409 |         return true;
   410 |     }
   411 | 
   412 |     private static string NormalizeMap(string? requestedMap)
   413 |     {
   414 |         var map = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedMap) ? "dota" : requestedMap.Trim();
   415 |         return map.All(character => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(character) || character is '_' or '-' or '/') &&
   416 |                !map.Contains("..", StringComparison.Ordinal)
   417 |             ? map
   418 |             : "dota";
   419 |     }
   420 | 
   421 |     private static int? TryGetExitCode(Process process)
   422 |     {
   423 |         try { return process.HasExited ? process.ExitCode : null; }
   424 |         catch (InvalidOperationException) { return null; }
   425 |     }

   430 |     }

   438 |         Stopped
   439 |     }

   444 |         {
   445 |             LobbyId = lobbyId;
   446 |             Port = port;
   447 |             Map = map;
   448 |             Process = process;
   449 |             StartedAt = startedAt;
   450 |         }

   453 |         public int Port { get; }
   454 |         public string Map { get; }
   455 |         public Process Process { get; }
   456 |         public DateTime StartedAt { get; }
   457 |         public ulong GameServerSteamId { get; set; }
   458 |         public DedicatedReservationState State { get; set; } = DedicatedReservationState.Starting;
   459 |         public string Error { get; set; } = string.Empty;
   460 |         public bool IsLive
   461 |         {
   462 |             get
   463 |             {
