   175 |     private static IReadOnlyList<DotaLobbyInviteRecord> ReadManyLocked(
   176 |         SqliteConnection connection,
   177 |         string where,
   178 |         SqliteTransaction? transaction,
   179 |         params (string Name, object Value)[] parameters)
   180 |     {
   181 |         var invites = new List<DotaLobbyInviteRecord>();
   182 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   183 |         command.Transaction = transaction;
   184 |         command.CommandText = $"SELECT * FROM lobby_invites WHERE {where} ORDER BY created_at DESC, invite_gid DESC";
   185 |         foreach (var parameter in parameters)
   186 |         {
   187 |             Add(command, parameter.Name, parameter.Value);
   188 |         }
   189 | 
   190 |         using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
   191 |         while (reader.Read())
   192 |         {
   193 |             invites.Add(new DotaLobbyInviteRecord
   194 |             {
   195 |                 LobbyId = U64(reader, "lobby_id"),
   196 |                 TargetSteamId = U64(reader, "target_steam_id"),
   197 |                 InviteGid = U64(reader, "invite_gid"),
   198 |                 SenderSteamId = U64(reader, "sender_steam_id"),
   199 |                 PayloadJson = Convert.ToString(reader["payload_json"]) ?? "{}",
   200 |                 CreatedAt = Convert.ToUInt32(reader["created_at"])
   201 |             });
   202 |         }
   203 | 
   204 |         return invites;
   205 |     }

   207 |     private static void DeleteLocked(
   208 |         SqliteConnection connection,
   209 |         SqliteTransaction transaction,

   221 |     private static ulong NextIdLocked(SqliteConnection connection, SqliteTransaction transaction)
   222 |     {
   223 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   224 |         command.Transaction = transaction;
   225 |         command.CommandText = "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(invite_gid), 0) FROM lobby_invites";
   226 |         var value = command.ExecuteScalar();
   227 |         var current = value == null || value == DBNull.Value ? 0UL : Convert.ToUInt64(value);
   228 |         var timeFloor = (ulong)DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() * 1000UL;
   229 |         return Math.Max(current + 1, timeFloor);
   230 |     }

   422 |     private bool IsLobbyAliveLocked(ApiLobby lobby)
   423 |     {
   424 |         if (lobby.Members.Count == 0)
   425 |         {
   426 |             return lobby.LobbyType == 4 && IsUserOnlineLocked(lobby.OwnerSteamId);
   427 |         }
   428 | 
   429 |             return IsUserOnlineLocked(lobby.OwnerSteamId) || lobby.Members.Any(member => IsUserOnlineLocked(member.SteamId));
   430 |         }
   431 | 
   432 |         private ApiLobby EnsureLobbyPeerAddressLocked(ApiLobby lobby)
   433 |         {
   434 |             // Peer-hosted lobbies (Farm Together etc.) are hosted by the lobby OWNER,
   435 |             // so publicIP/internalIP must be the owner's real address, not the central
   436 |             // AdvertisedServerIp (that is only meaningful for a Dota-style central game
   437 |             // server/SDR relay). Using the advertised server IP here made every lobby
   438 |             // claim the server host as its host: on a box that shares the server IP the
   439 |             // game treats the lobby as its own and hides it, and remote peers connect to
   440 |             // the server instead of the host. Prefer the owner session IP; fall back to
   441 |             // the advertised IP only when the owner address is unknown.
   442 |             var ownerIp = _state.WebSessions.Values
   443 |                 .Where(session => session.SteamId == lobby.OwnerSteamId && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(session.RemoteIp))
   444 |                 .OrderByDescending(session => session.LastSeenUtc)
   445 |                 .Select(session => session.RemoteIp)
   446 |                 .FirstOrDefault();
   447 | 
   448 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ownerIp) && TryGetConfiguredAdvertisedServerIp(out var configuredIp))
   449 |             {
   450 |                 ownerIp = ToIPv4String(configuredIp);
   451 |             }
   452 | 
   453 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ownerIp))
   454 |             {
   455 |                 return lobby;
   456 |             }
   457 | 
   458 |             // Some peer-hosted games expect the host address as lobby metadata.
   459 |             // Steam does not reserve these keys, but the legacy LAN path filled
   460 |             // them from the remote endpoint when a lobby arrived over the wire.
   461 |             // Preserve explicit game-provided values and only derive missing ones.
   462 |             if (!lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue("publicIP", out var publicIp) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(publicIp))
   463 |             {
   464 |                 lobby.LobbyData["publicIP"] = ownerIp;
   465 |             }
   466 | 
   467 |             if (!lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue("internalIP", out var internalIp) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(internalIp))
   468 |             {
   469 |                 lobby.LobbyData["internalIP"] = ownerIp;
   470 |             }
   471 | 
   472 |             return lobby;
   473 |         }
   474 | 
   475 |     private void RemoveLobbyLocked(ulong lobbyId)
   476 |     {
   477 |         if (!_state.Lobbies.Remove(lobbyId))
   478 |         {
   479 |             return;
   480 |         }
   481 | 
   482 |         foreach (var user in _state.Users.Values.Where(user => user.LobbyId == lobbyId))
   483 |         {
   484 |             user.LobbyId = 0;
   485 |         }
   486 | 
   487 |         EnqueueEvent(0, new ApiEvent { Type = "lobby_removed", LobbyId = lobbyId });
   488 |         SaveState();
   489 |     }
   490 | 
   491 |     private void RemoveConflictingOwnedLobbiesLocked(ulong ownerSteamId, uint appId, int lobbyType)
   492 |     {
   493 |         if (!IsRegularLobbyType(lobbyType))
   494 |         {
   495 |             return;
   496 |         }
   497 | 
   498 |         var conflictingLobbyIds = _state.Lobbies.Values
   499 |             .Where(lobby => lobby.AppId == appId && lobby.OwnerSteamId == ownerSteamId && IsRegularLobbyType(lobby.LobbyType))
   500 |             .Select(lobby => lobby.SteamId)
   501 |             .ToList();
   502 | 
   503 |         foreach (var lobbyId in conflictingLobbyIds)
   504 |         {
   505 |             RemoveLobbyLocked(lobbyId);
   506 |         }
   507 |     }
   508 | 
   509 |     private static bool IsRegularLobbyType(int lobbyType)
   510 |     {
   511 |         return lobbyType is >= 0 and <= 2;
   512 |     }
   513 | 
   514 |     private static int GetNearValueDistance(ApiLobby lobby, IReadOnlyList<ApiLobbyNearValueFilter> filters)
   515 |     {
   516 |         var distance = 0;
   517 |         foreach (var filter in filters)
   518 |         {
   519 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter.KeyToMatch) ||
   520 |                 !lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue(filter.KeyToMatch, out var value) ||
   521 |                 !int.TryParse(value, out var parsed))
   522 |             {
   523 |                 distance += int.MaxValue / Math.Max(1, filters.Count);
   524 |                 continue;
   525 |             }
   526 | 
   527 |             distance += Math.Abs(parsed - filter.ValueToBeCloseTo);
   528 |         }
   529 | 
   530 |         return distance;
   531 |     }
   532 | }

   157 |     private static string ResolveDataRoot(string contentRootPath, IConfiguration configuration)
   158 |     {
   159 |         var configuredRoot = configuration.GetValue<string>("Data:Root")?.Trim();
   160 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   161 |         {
   162 |             configuredRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SKYNET_DATA_ROOT")?.Trim();
   163 |         }
   164 | 
   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 | 
   185 |         return Path.Combine(root.FullName, "Data");
   186 |     }
   187 | }

     1 | // SKYNET_DEADLOCK_GS_HELLO_STATE_V1
     2 | 
     3 | /*
     4 |  * GameServerHello 4007 is sent more than once by Deadlock.
     5 |  *
     6 |  * First 4007:
     7 |  *   real GC login
     8 |  *   -> send 4005 GameServerWelcome
     9 |  *
    10 |  * Later 4007 from the SAME GameServer SteamID:
    11 |  *   keepalive / rehello
    12 |  *
    13 |  * Sending another empty 4005 after the server already owns
    14 |  * Lobby SO 101/102 causes Deadlock to unsubscribe that active
    15 |  * Lobby and call QuitServer().
    16 |  *
    17 |  * One active Deadlock dedicated is currently supervised at a time,
    18 |  * therefore remembering the most recently welcomed GameServer
    19 |  * SteamID is sufficient and also allows a newly launched dedicated
    20 |  * with a new SteamID to receive its normal first 4005.
    21 |  */
    22 | 
    23 | let deadlockWelcomedGameServerSteamId =
    24 |     0n;
    25 |

    27 |     steamId: bigint

    30 |         deadlockWelcomedGameServerSteamId !==
    31 |         0n &&
    32 |         deadlockWelcomedGameServerSteamId ===
    33 |         steamId
    34 |     );
    35 | }
    36 | 
    37 | export function markDeadlockGameServerWelcomed(
    38 |     steamId: bigint

    40 |     deadlockWelcomedGameServerSteamId =
    41 |         steamId;
    42 | }

   160 |     {
   161 |         var events = new List<object>();
   162 |         using var connection = OpenConnection();
   163 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   164 |         command.CommandText = """
   165 |             SELECT Id, LobbyId, EventType, DataJson, CreatedAtUtc
   166 |             FROM DedicatedServerEvents
   167 |             WHERE $lobbyId = '' OR LobbyId = $lobbyId

   172 |         command.Parameters.AddWithValue("$limit", Math.Clamp(limit, 1, 200));
   173 |         using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
   174 |         while (reader.Read())
   175 |         {
   176 |             events.Add(new
   177 |             {

   179 |                 lobbyId = reader.GetString(1),
   180 |                 eventType = reader.GetString(2),
   181 |                 dataJson = reader.GetString(3),

   189 |     private void Upsert(string lobbyId, string map, uint port, bool started, string status, string error, string gameServerSteamId)
   190 |     {
   191 |         using var connection = OpenConnection();
   192 |         Execute(connection, """
   193 |             INSERT INTO DedicatedServers (LobbyId, Map, Port, Started, Status, Error, GameServerSteamId, UpdatedAtUtc)
   194 |             VALUES ($lobbyId, $map, $port, $started, $status, $error, $gameServerSteamId, $now)
   195 |             ON CONFLICT(LobbyId) DO UPDATE SET
   196 |                 Map = excluded.Map,
   197 |                 Port = excluded.Port,
   198 |                 Started = excluded.Started,
   199 |                 Status = excluded.Status,
   200 |                 Error = excluded.Error,
   201 |                 GameServerSteamId = excluded.GameServerSteamId,
   202 |                 UpdatedAtUtc = excluded.UpdatedAtUtc;
   203 |             """,
   204 |             ("$lobbyId", lobbyId ?? "0"),
   205 |             ("$map", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(map) ? "dota" : map),
   206 |             ("$port", port),
   207 |             ("$started", started ? 1 : 0),
   208 |             ("$status", status ?? string.Empty),
   209 |             ("$error", error ?? string.Empty),
   210 |             ("$gameServerSteamId", string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(gameServerSteamId) ? "0" : gameServerSteamId),
   211 |             ("$now", UtcNow()));
   212 |     }

   217 |         {
   218 |             using var connection = OpenConnection();

   224 |                 ("$eventType", eventType ?? string.Empty),
   225 |                 ("$dataJson", NormalizeJson(dataJson, "{}")),
   226 |                 ("$now", UtcNow()));
   227 |         }
   228 |         catch (Exception ex)
   229 |         {
   230 |             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not record dedicated server event {EventType} for lobby {LobbyId}", eventType, lobbyId);
   231 |         }
   232 |     }

    52 |     public DedicatedLaunchResult Start(ulong lobbyId, string? requestedMap)
    53 |     {
    54 |         if (lobbyId == 0)
    55 |         {
    56 |             return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("Lobby id is required.");
    57 |         }
    58 | 
    59 |         // Read the live settings once per launch so an admin edit takes effect on
    60 |         // the next dedicated server without a restart.
    61 |         var settings = _settings.Current;
    62 | 
    63 |         lock (_sync)
    64 |         {
    65 |             SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);
    66 |             if (_reservations.TryGetValue(lobbyId, out var existing) && existing.IsLive)
    67 |             {
    68 |                 return new DedicatedLaunchResult(true, existing.Port, existing.State, string.Empty);
    69 |             }
    70 | 
    71 |             if (!settings.DedicatedEnabled)
    72 |             {
    73 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("Dedicated servers are disabled by configuration.");
    74 |             }
    75 | 
    76 |             if (!File.Exists(_executablePath))
    77 |             {
    78 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated executable was not found at '{_executablePath}'.");
    79 |             }
    80 | 
    81 |             if (!Directory.Exists(_workingDirectory))
    82 |             {
    83 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated working directory was not found at '{_workingDirectory}'.");
    84 |             }
    85 | 
    86 |             if (!File.Exists(_payloadDllPath))
    87 |             {
    88 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed($"Dota dedicated emulator payload was not found at '{_payloadDllPath}'.");
    89 |             }
    90 | 
    91 |             var port = AllocatePortLocked(settings.DedicatedPortStart);
    92 |             if (port == 0)
    93 |             {
    94 |                 return DedicatedLaunchResult.Failed("No available UDP/TCP port was found for a dedicated server.");
    95 |             }
    96 | 
    97 |             var map = NormalizeMap(requestedMap);
    98 |             var arguments = new List<string>
    99 |             {
   100 |                 "-dedicated"
   101 |             };
   102 |             // Always insecure: the emulator cannot produce a valid VAC session, so a
   103 |             // "secure" dedicated only ever yields the client VAC popup/block. Passing
   104 |             // -insecure keeps dota2 from loading the VAC module at all.
   105 |             arguments.Add("-insecure");
   106 |             // Bind explicitly. Recent Dota dedicated builds can otherwise pick a
   107 |             // single interface, leaving advertised endpoints black-holed.
   108 |             if (TryNormalizeIPv4(settings.DedicatedBindIp, out var bindIp))
   109 |             {
   110 |                 arguments.Add("-ip");
   111 |                 arguments.Add(bindIp);
   112 |             }
   113 |             arguments.Add("-port");
   114 |             arguments.Add(port.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
   115 |             arguments.Add("+tv_port");
   116 |             arguments.Add((port + _tvPortOffset).ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture));
   117 |             arguments.Add("+sv_lan");
   118 |             arguments.Add("0");
   119 |             // Generous netchannel timeout. A peer with a weaker CPU or missing
   120 |             // cosmetic assets can stall the client for 10-20s during the hero-select
   121 |             // loadout (EconItemSearch / UGC image resolution), going silent on the
   122 |             // wire; the default ~20s server timeout then drops it mid-load. Real
   123 |             // matchmaking is lenient during loading, so widen the window.
   124 |             arguments.Add("+cl_timeout");
   125 |             arguments.Add("120");
   126 |             arguments.Add("+map");
   127 |             arguments.Add(map);
   128 |             arguments.Add("-console");
   129 |             arguments.Add("-vconsole");
   130 |             arguments.Add("-novid");
   131 | 
   132 |             var environmentVariables = new Dictionary<string, string>(StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   133 |             {
   134 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_LOBBY_ID"] = lobbyId.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
   135 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_PORT"] = port.ToString(System.Globalization.CultureInfo.InvariantCulture),
   136 |                 ["SKYNET_PROCESS_ROLE"] = "dedicated",
   137 |                 ["SKYNET_LOG_SUFFIX"] = $"dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}",
   138 |                 ["SKYNET_DEDICATED_INSECURE"] = "1"
   139 |             };
   140 | 
   141 |             try
   142 |             {
   143 |                 Directory.CreateDirectory(_diagnosticsDirectory);
   144 |                 var outputPath = Path.Combine(_diagnosticsDirectory, $"dota_dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}_stdout.log");
   145 |                 var errorPath = Path.Combine(_diagnosticsDirectory, $"dota_dedicated_{lobbyId}_{port}_stderr.log");
   146 |                 // The dedicated process is injected before it runs so it uses the
   147 |                 // launcher's payload DLL, not any stale steam_api64.dll beside Dota.
   148 |                 // steam_api resolves its ini and SKYNET logs from Dota's exe folder,
   149 |                 // while the executable bytes remain untouched on disk.

   151 |                     _executablePath,
   152 |                     _payloadDllPath,

   154 |                     _workingDirectory,

   158 |                 File.WriteAllText(errorPath, string.Empty);

   163 |                     "Started Dota dedicated server pid {ProcessId} for lobby {LobbyId} on port {Port} map {Map}. Payload: {Payload}. Args: {Arguments}. Stdout: {StdoutPath}. Stderr: {StderrPath}",

   165 |                 return new DedicatedLaunchResult(true, port, reservation.State, string.Empty);
   166 |             }

   175 |     // GCGameServerInfo is the authoritative point at which a server identity
   176 |     // becomes usable. Match on the reserved game port, never on arrival order.
   177 |     public string ClaimLobby(ulong gameServerSteamId, uint reportedPort)
   178 |     {
   179 |         if (gameServerSteamId == 0 || reportedPort == 0)
   180 |         {
   181 |             return "0";

   186 |             SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);

   203 |                 }
   204 |             }
   205 |

   227 |     public void ObserveRegistration(ulong gameServerSteamId, ApiGameServer server)

   230 |         {

   278 |     protected override async Task ExecuteAsync(CancellationToken stoppingToken)
   279 |     {
   280 |         using var timer = new PeriodicTimer(TimeSpan.FromSeconds(1));
   281 |         try
   282 |         {
   283 |             while (await timer.WaitForNextTickAsync(stoppingToken))
   284 |             {
   285 |                 lock (_sync)
   286 |                 {
   287 |                     SweepLocked(DateTime.UtcNow);
   288 |                 }
   289 |             }
   290 |         }
   291 |         catch (OperationCanceledException) when (stoppingToken.IsCancellationRequested)
   292 |         {
   293 |         }

   296 |     public override Task StopAsync(CancellationToken cancellationToken)
   297 |     {
   298 |         lock (_sync)
   299 |         {
   300 |             foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
   301 |             {
   302 |                 StopProcess(reservation, "SKYNET server stopped");
   303 |             }
   304 |             _reservations.Clear();
   305 |         }
   306 | 
   307 |         return base.StopAsync(cancellationToken);
   308 |     }
   309 | 
   310 |     private void SweepLocked(DateTime now)
   311 |     {
   312 |         foreach (var reservation in _reservations.Values)
   313 |         {
   314 |             if (!reservation.IsLive && reservation.State is not DedicatedReservationState.Failed and not DedicatedReservationState.Stopped)
   315 |             {
   316 |                 reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Failed;
   317 |                 reservation.Error = "Dedicated Dota process exited before the match was ready.";
   318 |                 _logger.LogWarning(
   319 |                     "Dedicated server for lobby {LobbyId} stopped before ready. Exit code: {ExitCode}",
   320 |                     reservation.LobbyId, TryGetExitCode(reservation.Process));
   321 |             }
   322 |             else if (reservation.State == DedicatedReservationState.Starting &&
   323 |                      now - reservation.StartedAt > _startupTimeout)
   324 |             {
   325 |                 reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Failed;
   326 |                 reservation.Error = "Timed out waiting for the dedicated server GC handshake.";
   327 |                 StopProcess(reservation, reservation.Error);
   328 |                 _logger.LogWarning("Dedicated server for lobby {LobbyId} timed out waiting for GC handshake", reservation.LobbyId);
   329 |             }
   330 |         }
   331 |     }
   332 | 
   333 |     private int AllocatePortLocked(int portStart)
   334 |     {
   335 |         for (var port = portStart; port <= Math.Min(65534, portStart + 256); port++)
   336 |         {
   337 |             if (_reservations.Values.Any(reservation => reservation.IsLive && reservation.Port == port))
   338 |             {
   339 |                 continue;
   340 |             }
   341 | 
   342 |             if (CanBindPort(port))
   343 |             {
   344 |                 return port;
   345 |             }
   346 |         }
   347 | 
   348 |         return 0;
   349 |     }
   350 | 
   351 |     private static bool CanBindPort(int port)
   352 |     {
   353 |         try
   354 |         {
   355 |             using var tcp = new TcpListener(IPAddress.Any, port);
   356 |             tcp.Start();
   357 |             using var udp = new Socket(AddressFamily.InterNetwork, SocketType.Dgram, ProtocolType.Udp);
   358 |             udp.Bind(new IPEndPoint(IPAddress.Any, port));
   359 |             return true;
   360 |         }
   361 |         catch (SocketException)
   362 |         {
   363 |             return false;
   364 |         }
   365 |     }
   366 | 
   367 |     private void StopProcess(DedicatedReservation reservation, string reason)
   368 |     {
   369 |         if (reservation.State != DedicatedReservationState.Failed)
   370 |         {
   371 |             reservation.State = DedicatedReservationState.Stopped;
   372 |         }
   373 | 
   374 |         try
   375 |         {
   376 |             if (!reservation.Process.HasExited)
   377 |             {
   378 |                 reservation.Process.Kill(entireProcessTree: true);
   379 |                 _logger.LogInformation(
   380 |                     "Stopped dedicated Dota pid {ProcessId} for lobby {LobbyId}: {Reason}",
   381 |                     reservation.Process.Id, reservation.LobbyId, reason);
   382 |             }
   383 |         }
   384 |         catch (InvalidOperationException)
   385 |         {
   386 |         }
   387 |         catch (Exception ex)
   388 |         {
   389 |             _logger.LogWarning(ex, "Could not stop dedicated Dota process for lobby {LobbyId}", reservation.LobbyId);
   390 |         }
   391 |     }
   392 | 
   393 |     private static string ResolvePath(string? configured, string contentRoot, string fallback)
   394 |     {
   395 |         var value = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configured) ? fallback : configured.Trim();
   396 |         return Path.GetFullPath(Path.IsPathRooted(value) ? value : Path.Combine(contentRoot, value));
   397 |     }
   398 | 
   399 |     private static bool TryNormalizeIPv4(string value, out string normalized)
   400 |     {
   401 |         normalized = string.Empty;
   402 |         if (!IPAddress.TryParse(value, out var parsed) || parsed.AddressFamily != AddressFamily.InterNetwork ||
   403 |             IPAddress.IsLoopback(parsed))
   404 |         {
   405 |             return false;
   406 |         }
   407 | 
   408 |         normalized = parsed.ToString();
   409 |         return true;
   410 |     }
   411 | 
   412 |     private static string NormalizeMap(string? requestedMap)
   413 |     {
   414 |         var map = string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(requestedMap) ? "dota" : requestedMap.Trim();
   415 |         return map.All(character => char.IsAsciiLetterOrDigit(character) || character is '_' or '-' or '/') &&
   416 |                !map.Contains("..", StringComparison.Ordinal)
   417 |             ? map
   418 |             : "dota";
   419 |     }
   420 | 
   421 |     private static int? TryGetExitCode(Process process)
   422 |     {
   423 |         try { return process.HasExited ? process.ExitCode : null; }
   424 |         catch (InvalidOperationException) { return null; }
   425 |     }

   162 |         SqliteConnection connection,

   175 |     private static IReadOnlyList<DotaLobbyInviteRecord> ReadManyLocked(
   176 |         SqliteConnection connection,
   177 |         string where,
   178 |         SqliteTransaction? transaction,
   179 |         params (string Name, object Value)[] parameters)
   180 |     {
   181 |         var invites = new List<DotaLobbyInviteRecord>();
   182 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   183 |         command.Transaction = transaction;
   184 |         command.CommandText = $"SELECT * FROM lobby_invites WHERE {where} ORDER BY created_at DESC, invite_gid DESC";
   185 |         foreach (var parameter in parameters)
   186 |         {
   187 |             Add(command, parameter.Name, parameter.Value);
   188 |         }
   189 | 
   190 |         using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
   191 |         while (reader.Read())
   192 |         {
   193 |             invites.Add(new DotaLobbyInviteRecord
   194 |             {
   195 |                 LobbyId = U64(reader, "lobby_id"),
   196 |                 TargetSteamId = U64(reader, "target_steam_id"),
   197 |                 InviteGid = U64(reader, "invite_gid"),
   198 |                 SenderSteamId = U64(reader, "sender_steam_id"),
   199 |                 PayloadJson = Convert.ToString(reader["payload_json"]) ?? "{}",
   200 |                 CreatedAt = Convert.ToUInt32(reader["created_at"])
   201 |             });
   202 |         }
   203 | 
   204 |         return invites;
   205 |     }

   207 |     private static void DeleteLocked(
   208 |         SqliteConnection connection,
   209 |         SqliteTransaction transaction,

   211 |         ulong targetSteamId)
   212 |     {
   213 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();

   221 |     private static ulong NextIdLocked(SqliteConnection connection, SqliteTransaction transaction)
   222 |     {
   223 |         using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   224 |         command.Transaction = transaction;
   225 |         command.CommandText = "SELECT COALESCE(MAX(invite_gid), 0) FROM lobby_invites";
   226 |         var value = command.ExecuteScalar();
   227 |         var current = value == null || value == DBNull.Value ? 0UL : Convert.ToUInt64(value);
   228 |         var timeFloor = (ulong)DateTimeOffset.UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds() * 1000UL;
   229 |         return Math.Max(current + 1, timeFloor);
   230 |     }
   231 | 
   232 |     private static void Add(SqliteCommand command, string name, object? value)
   233 |     {
   234 |         command.Parameters.AddWithValue(name, value is ulong unsigned ? checked((long)unsigned) : value ?? DBNull.Value);
   235 |     }

   753 |     public DotaStatsReporterUpdateSummary GetReporterUpdates(uint reporterAccountId, int limit = 50)
   754 |     {
   755 |         lock (_sync)
   756 |         {
   757 |             using var connection = OpenConnection();
   758 |             var totalReports = (uint)ScalarLong(
   759 |                 connection,
   760 |                 null,
   761 |                 "SELECT COUNT(*) FROM reports WHERE reporter_account_id = $reporter_account_id",
   762 |                 ("$reporter_account_id", reporterAccountId));
   763 | 
   764 |             using var command = connection.CreateCommand();
   765 |             command.CommandText = """
   766 |                 SELECT
   767 |                     CASE WHEN r.debug_match_id != 0 THEN r.debug_match_id ELSE r.lobby_id END AS match_id,
   768 |                     COALESCE(mp.hero_id, 0) AS hero_id,
   769 |                     r.report_reasons_csv,
   770 |                     r.report_flags,
   771 |                     r.created_at
   772 |                 FROM reports r
   773 |                 LEFT JOIN match_players mp ON mp.match_id = r.debug_match_id AND mp.account_id = r.target_account_id
   774 |                 WHERE r.reporter_account_id = $reporter_account_id
   775 |                   AND NOT EXISTS (
   776 |                       SELECT 1
   777 |                       FROM reporter_update_acks a
   778 |                       WHERE a.account_id = r.reporter_account_id
   779 |                         AND a.match_id = CASE WHEN r.debug_match_id != 0 THEN r.debug_match_id ELSE r.lobby_id END
   780 |                   )
   781 |                 ORDER BY r.created_at DESC, r.id DESC
   782 |                 LIMIT $limit
   783 |                 """;
   784 |             Add(command, "$reporter_account_id", reporterAccountId);
   785 |             Add(command, "$limit", Math.Clamp(limit, 1, 200));
   786 | 
   787 |             var updates = new List<DotaStatsReporterUpdate>();
   788 |             using var reader = command.ExecuteReader();
   789 |             while (reader.Read())
   790 |             {
   791 |                 updates.Add(new DotaStatsReporterUpdate
   792 |                 {
   793 |                     MatchId = unchecked((ulong)reader.GetInt64(0)),
   794 |                     HeroId = unchecked((uint)reader.GetInt64(1)),
   795 |                     ReportReason = FirstCsvUInt32(reader.GetString(2), unchecked((uint)reader.GetInt64(3))),
   796 |                     Timestamp = unchecked((uint)reader.GetInt64(4))
   797 |                 });
   798 |             }
   799 | 
   800 |             return new DotaStatsReporterUpdateSummary
   801 |             {
   802 |                 Updates = updates,
   803 |                 NumReported = totalReports,
   804 |                 NumNoActionTaken = totalReports
   805 |             };
   806 |         }

   141 |         ulong lobbyId,

  7786 |     private DotaStatsProfile GetStatsProfile(uint accountId)
  7787 |     {
  7788 |         var store = DotaGcRuntimeServices.StatsStore;
  7789 |         return store == null
  7790 |             ? DefaultProfile(accountId)
  7791 |             : accountId == _context.AccountId
  7792 |                 ? store.EnsureProfile(_context.SteamId, _context.AccountId, _context.PersonaName)
  7793 |                 : store.GetProfile(accountId);
  7794 |     }
  7795 | 
  7796 |     private TsValue ToTsProfileSnapshot(uint requestedAccountId)
  7797 |     {
  7798 |         var store = DotaGcRuntimeServices.StatsStore;
  7799 |         var profile = store == null
  7800 |             ? DefaultProfile(requestedAccountId)
  7801 |             : requestedAccountId == _context.AccountId
  7802 |                 ? store.EnsureProfile(_context.SteamId, _context.AccountId, _context.PersonaName)
  7803 |                 : store.GetProfile(requestedAccountId);
  7804 | 
  7805 |         var global = store?.GetGlobalStats(profile.AccountId) ?? new DotaStatsGlobalStats { AccountId = profile.AccountId };
  7806 |         var conduct = store?.GetConduct(profile.AccountId) ?? new DotaStatsConduct { AccountId = profile.AccountId };

   432 |         private ApiLobby EnsureLobbyPeerAddressLocked(ApiLobby lobby)
   433 |         {
   434 |             // Peer-hosted lobbies (Farm Together etc.) are hosted by the lobby OWNER,
   435 |             // so publicIP/internalIP must be the owner's real address, not the central
   436 |             // AdvertisedServerIp (that is only meaningful for a Dota-style central game
   437 |             // server/SDR relay). Using the advertised server IP here made every lobby
   438 |             // claim the server host as its host: on a box that shares the server IP the
   439 |             // game treats the lobby as its own and hides it, and remote peers connect to
   440 |             // the server instead of the host. Prefer the owner session IP; fall back to
   441 |             // the advertised IP only when the owner address is unknown.
   442 |             var ownerIp = _state.WebSessions.Values
   443 |                 .Where(session => session.SteamId == lobby.OwnerSteamId && !string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(session.RemoteIp))
   444 |                 .OrderByDescending(session => session.LastSeenUtc)
   445 |                 .Select(session => session.RemoteIp)
   446 |                 .FirstOrDefault();
   447 | 
   448 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ownerIp) && TryGetConfiguredAdvertisedServerIp(out var configuredIp))
   449 |             {
   450 |                 ownerIp = ToIPv4String(configuredIp);
   451 |             }
   452 | 
   453 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(ownerIp))
   454 |             {
   455 |                 return lobby;
   456 |             }
   457 | 
   458 |             // Some peer-hosted games expect the host address as lobby metadata.
   459 |             // Steam does not reserve these keys, but the legacy LAN path filled
   460 |             // them from the remote endpoint when a lobby arrived over the wire.
   461 |             // Preserve explicit game-provided values and only derive missing ones.
   462 |             if (!lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue("publicIP", out var publicIp) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(publicIp))
   463 |             {
   464 |                 lobby.LobbyData["publicIP"] = ownerIp;
   465 |             }
   466 | 
   467 |             if (!lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue("internalIP", out var internalIp) || string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(internalIp))
   468 |             {
   469 |                 lobby.LobbyData["internalIP"] = ownerIp;
   470 |             }
   471 | 
   472 |             return lobby;
   473 |         }
   474 |

   514 |     private static int GetNearValueDistance(ApiLobby lobby, IReadOnlyList<ApiLobbyNearValueFilter> filters)
   515 |     {
   516 |         var distance = 0;
   517 |         foreach (var filter in filters)
   518 |         {
   519 |             if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(filter.KeyToMatch) ||
   520 |                 !lobby.LobbyData.TryGetValue(filter.KeyToMatch, out var value) ||
   521 |                 !int.TryParse(value, out var parsed))
   522 |             {
   523 |                 distance += int.MaxValue / Math.Max(1, filters.Count);
   524 |                 continue;
   525 |             }
   526 | 
   527 |             distance += Math.Abs(parsed - filter.ValueToBeCloseTo);
   528 |         }
   529 | 
   530 |         return distance;
   531 |     }

   329 |     // Fills the viewer-facing GameState/HeroId from live presence + active match,

   331 |     // bare online flag with stale rich presence.
   332 |     private void ApplyDerivedPresenceLocked(ApiUser clone)
   333 |     {
   334 |         if (!IsUserOnlineLocked(clone.SteamId))
   335 |         {
   336 |             // Offline: report no game/lobby/rich presence so friends never show
   337 |             // an offline user as "In game". GetFriendGamePlayed on the client is
   338 |             // driven by AppId, so it must be zeroed here.
   339 |             clone.PersonaState = 0;

   352 |         clone.HeroId = 0;

   369 |             }
   370 |         }

   157 |     private static string ResolveDataRoot(string contentRootPath, IConfiguration configuration)
   158 |     {
   159 |         var configuredRoot = configuration.GetValue<string>("Data:Root")?.Trim();
   160 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   161 |         {
   162 |             configuredRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SKYNET_DATA_ROOT")?.Trim();
   163 |         }
   164 | 
   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 | 
   185 |         return Path.Combine(root.FullName, "Data");
   186 |     }

    30 | public static class GameCoordinatorPendingMessages
    31 | {
    32 |     private const int MaxQueuedPerRecipient = 256;
    33 |     private static readonly object Sync = new();
    34 |     private static readonly Dictionary<(uint AppId, ulong SteamId), Queue<ApiGCMessage>> Queues = new();
    35 | 
    36 |     public static void Enqueue(uint appId, ulong steamId, ApiGCMessage message)
    37 |     {
    38 |         lock (Sync)
    39 |         {
    40 |             if (!Queues.TryGetValue((appId, steamId), out var queue))
    41 |             {
    42 |                 queue = new Queue<ApiGCMessage>();
    43 |                 Queues[(appId, steamId)] = queue;
    44 |             }
    45 | 
    46 |             queue.Enqueue(message);
    47 |             while (queue.Count > MaxQueuedPerRecipient)
    48 |             {
    49 |                 queue.Dequeue();
    50 |             }
    51 |         }
    52 |     }
    53 | 
    54 |     public static List<ApiGCMessage> Drain(uint appId, ulong steamId)
    55 |     {
    56 |         lock (Sync)
    57 |         {
    58 |             if (!Queues.TryGetValue((appId, steamId), out var queue) || queue.Count == 0)
    59 |             {
    60 |                 return new List<ApiGCMessage>();
    61 |             }
    62 | 
    63 |             var drained = queue.ToList();
    64 |             Queues.Remove((appId, steamId));
    65 |             return drained;
    66 |         }
    67 |     }
    68 | }
    69 |

    71 | {

    75 |     {
    76 |         _plugins = plugins.ToList();
    77 |     }
    78 | 
    79 |     public ApiGCExchangeResponse Exchange(GameCoordinatorContext context, ApiGCExchangeRequest request)
    80 |     {
    81 |         var plugin = _plugins.FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.CanHandle(context.AppId));
    82 |         if (plugin == null)
    83 |         {
    84 |             return new ApiGCExchangeResponse();
    85 |         }
    86 | 
    87 |         return plugin.Exchange(context, request) ?? new ApiGCExchangeResponse();
    88 |     }
    89 | 
    90 |     public ApiGCExchangeResponse Poll(GameCoordinatorContext context)
    91 |     {
    92 |         var plugin = _plugins.FirstOrDefault(candidate => candidate.CanHandle(context.AppId));
    93 |         if (plugin == null)
    94 |         {
    95 |             return new ApiGCExchangeResponse();
    96 |         }
    97 | 
    98 |         return plugin.Poll(context) ?? new ApiGCExchangeResponse();
    99 |     }
   100 | }

   495 |     private static string GetScriptCacheKey(GameCoordinatorAppDefinition app)
   496 |     {
   497 |         var fileIdentities = EnumerateRuntimeScriptFiles(app)
   498 |             .OrderBy(path => path, StringComparer.OrdinalIgnoreCase)
   499 |             .Select(path =>
   500 |             {
   501 |                 var file = new FileInfo(path);
   502 |                 return string.Join(':', Path.GetRelativePath(app.RootPath, path), file.Length, file.LastWriteTimeUtc.Ticks);
   503 |             });
   504 | 
   505 |         return string.Join('|', new[] { app.RuntimeCacheKey }.Concat(fileIdentities));
   506 |     }

    45 |                 _entries.Dequeue();
    46 |             }

    34 |         }

    81 |     // Called from the ~54 mutation sites (via SaveState). Non-blocking: marks the
    82 |     // durable state dirty and wakes the background flusher, which coalesces bursts
    83 |     // and writes to steam.db/dota.db off the request path.
    84 |     private void RequestStateFlush()
    85 |     {
    86 |         Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flushPending, 1);
    87 |         _flushSignal.Set();
    88 |     }
    89 | 
    90 |     // Marks the (large, static) Dota item catalog dirty so the next flush rewrites
    91 |     // it. Called only when a cosmetics import changes the catalog.
    92 |     private void RequestCatalogFlush()
    93 |     {
    94 |         Interlocked.Exchange(ref _catalogPending, 1);
    95 |         Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flushPending, 1);
    96 |         _flushSignal.Set();
    97 |     }

    99 |     private void StartBackgroundFlusher()
   100 |     {
   101 |         if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flusherStarted, 1) == 1)
   102 |         {
   103 |             return;
   104 |         }
   105 | 
   106 |         var thread = new Thread(FlushLoop) { IsBackground = true, Name = "StatePersistenceFlusher" };
   107 |         thread.Start();
   108 |     }
   109 | 
   110 |     private void FlushLoop()
   111 |     {
   112 |         var consecutiveFailures = 0;
   113 |         while (true)
   114 |         {
   115 |             _flushSignal.Wait();
   116 |             _flushSignal.Reset();
   117 |             // Coalesce a burst of mutations into a single write.
   118 |             Thread.Sleep(500);
   119 | 
   120 |             var includeCatalog = Interlocked.Exchange(ref _catalogPending, 0) == 1;
   121 |             if (Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flushPending, 0) == 0 && !includeCatalog)
   122 |             {
   123 |                 continue;
   124 |             }
   125 | 
   126 |             try
   127 |             {
   128 |                 FlushToDatabase(includeCatalog);
   129 |                 consecutiveFailures = 0;
   130 |             }
   131 |             catch (Exception ex)
   132 |             {
   133 |                 consecutiveFailures++;
   134 |                 // Keep the work pending and schedule a retry with capped backoff,
   135 |                 // instead of waiting (possibly forever) for the next mutation.
   136 |                 Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flushPending, 1);
   137 |                 if (includeCatalog)
   138 |                 {
   139 |                     Interlocked.Exchange(ref _catalogPending, 1);
   140 |                 }
   141 | 
   142 |                 _logger.LogWarning(ex, "State flush to steam.db/dota.db failed (attempt {Attempt}); retrying.", consecutiveFailures);
   143 |                 Thread.Sleep(Math.Min(30_000, 500 * (1 << Math.Min(consecutiveFailures, 6))));
   144 |                 _flushSignal.Set();
   145 |             }
   146 |         }
   147 |     }
   148 | 
   149 |     private void FlushToDatabase(bool includeCatalog)
   150 |     {
   151 |         // Project the state under the lock (fast, in-memory), then do the database
   152 |         // I/O outside it. Write rewrites only the tables whose content changed.
   153 |         StateSnapshot snapshot;
   154 |         lock (_sync)
   155 |         {
   156 |             snapshot = StatePersistence.BuildSnapshot(_state, includeCatalog);
   157 |         }
   158 | 
   159 |         lock (_flushIoLock)
   160 |         {
   161 |             using var steam = _steamDbFactory.CreateDbContext();
   162 |             using var dota = _dotaDbFactory.CreateDbContext();
   163 |             _lastFlushHashes = StatePersistence.Write(steam, dota, snapshot, _lastFlushHashes);
   164 |         }
   165 |     }
   166 | 
   167 |     // Synchronous, full flush (including the catalog). Used on graceful shutdown
   168 |     // so no in-flight change is lost between the last background write and exit.
   169 |     public void FlushStateToDatabase()
   170 |     {
   171 |         Interlocked.Exchange(ref _flushPending, 0);
   172 |         Interlocked.Exchange(ref _catalogPending, 0);
   173 |         FlushToDatabase(includeCatalog: true);
   174 |     }
   175 | }

   159 |         var configuredRoot = configuration.GetValue<string>("Data:Root")?.Trim();
   160 |         if (string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))

   162 |             configuredRoot = Environment.GetEnvironmentVariable("SKYNET_DATA_ROOT")?.Trim();
   163 |         }
   164 | 
   165 |         if (!string.IsNullOrWhiteSpace(configuredRoot))
   166 |         {
   167 |             return Path.GetFullPath(configuredRoot);
   168 |         }
   169 | 
   170 |         var root = new DirectoryInfo(Path.GetFullPath(contentRootPath));
   171 |         for (var current = root; current != null; current = current.Parent)
   172 |         {
   173 |             if (File.Exists(Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server.csproj")))
   174 |             {
   175 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "Data");
   176 |             }
   177 | 
   178 |             var nestedProject = Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "SKYNET server.csproj");
   179 |             if (File.Exists(nestedProject))
   180 |             {
   181 |                 return Path.Combine(current.FullName, "SKYNET server", "Data");
   182 |             }
   183 |         }
   184 |
